results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.9, what conditions must be met for Event B2 to occur?

options.A: PCell becomes worse than threshold1 AND SCell becomes better than threshold2
options.B: PCell becomes better than threshold1 AND inter-RAT neighbour becomes worse than threshold2
options.C: PCell becomes worse than threshold1 AND inter-RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2
options.D: PCell becomes worse than threshold1 OR inter-RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-1 and B2-2, as specified below, are both satisfied, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-3 or B2-4, as specified below, is satisfied. Inequality B2-1 (Entering condition 1): Mn1 + Ofn1 + Ocn1 - Hys < Thresh1. Inequality B2-2 (Entering condition 2): Mn2 + Ofn2 + Ocn2 - Hys > Thresh2. Inequality B2-3 (Leaving condition 1): Mn1 + Ofn1 + Ocn1 + Hys > Thresh1. Inequality B2-4 (Leaving condition 2): Mn2 + Ofn2 + Ocn2 + Hys < Thresh2. The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Mn1 is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn1 is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the serving cell. Ocn1 is the cell specific offset of the serving cell, and set to zero if not configured for the serving cell. Mn2 is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell on the other frequency, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn2 is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell. Ocn2 is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell, and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. threshold1-r17). Thresh2 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. threshold2-r17). Mn1, Ofn1, Ocn1 are expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Mn2, Ofn2, Ocn2 are expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Thresh1 is expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Thresh2 is expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR.

results.question: Which of the following correctly describes the triggering mechanism for Event B2?

options.A: Triggered when PCell quality deteriorates below threshold1, regardless of inter-RAT conditions
options.B: Triggered when inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2, regardless of PCell conditions
options.C: Triggered only when both PCell deteriorates below threshold1 AND inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2
options.D: Triggered when either PCell deteriorates below threshold1 OR inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: Event B2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold1 and inter-RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-3 or B2-4, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality B2-1 (Entering condition 1): Mp + Ofp + Ocp – Hys < Thresh1. Inequality B2-2 (Entering condition 2): Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Thresh2. Inequality B2-3 (Leaving condition 1): Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Hys > Thresh1. Inequality B2-4 (Leaving condition 2): Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Thresh2. The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Mp is the measurement result of the PCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofp is the frequency specific offset of the primary frequency (i.e. offsetFreq as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the primary frequency). Ocp is the cell specific offset of the PCell, and set to zero if not configured for the PCell. Mn is the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the inter-RAT neighbour cell. Ocn is the cell specific offset of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, set to zero if not configured. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh1 is expressed in the same unit as Mp. Thresh2 is expressed in the same unit as Mn. Mp is expressed in dBm or dBm for RSRP, in dB for RSRQ. Mn is expressed in dBm or dBm for RSRP for the other RAT, or dB for RSRQ. Both entering conditions B2-1 and B2-2 need to be satisfied simultaneously for the event to be triggered, while either leaving condition B2-3 or B2-4 being satisfied causes the event to leave.

results.question: What type of measurement event is Event B2 primarily concerned with?

options.A: Intra-frequency LTE neighbour cell measurement
options.B: Inter-frequency NR neighbour cell measurement
options.C: Inter-RAT neighbour cell measurement
options.D: Primary cell only measurement without neighbour consideration

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: Event B2 (Neighbour becomes better than threshold1 and inter-RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when both condition B2-1 and condition B2-2, as specified below, are fulfilled. Event B2 is used for inter-RAT measurement reporting, where the serving cell becomes worse than one threshold (threshold1) while a neighbouring cell on another RAT becomes better than another threshold (threshold2), triggering the UE to report for potential inter-RAT handover.

results.question: In Event B2, what is the relationship between the two triggering conditions?

options.A: The conditions are independent - either one can trigger the event
options.B: The conditions are mutually exclusive - only one can be true at a time
options.C: The conditions must both be satisfied concurrently

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when both condition B2-1 and condition B2-2, as specified below, are fulfilled, and shall consider the leaving condition to be satisfied when either condition B2-3 or condition B2-4, as specified below, is fulfilled.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.2, when a UE sets the contents of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message, what action does it take for each sidelink DRB that is to be released due to configuration by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, or by upper layers?

results.evidence: 1> for each sidelink DRB, identified by sl-DRB-Identity, that is to be released due to configuration by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or by upper layers: 2> release the PDCP entity, the SLRB and the associated sl-DRB-Identity; 2> if configured, release the RLC bearer for the associated PC5 relay RLC channel.

results.question: In TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.2, for a UE in RRC_CONNECTED performing sidelink operation with resource allocation mode 1, how does it set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 when the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList?

options.B: It is up to UE implementation to set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5.
options.C: The UE determines the sidelink DRX configuration for unicast for the associated peer UE.
options.D: According to stored NR sidelink measurement configuration information for this destination.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.2, Actions related to transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in the sl-FreqInfoToAddModList within the SIB12 or within the SidelinkPreconfigNR: 2> if sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 is not included in the SL-ConfigDedicatedNR received in RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume: 3> set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 to include the sl-DRX-Config for unicast configured by sl-DRX-ConfigGC-BC within the sl-FreqInfoToAddModList corresponding to the frequency used for NR sidelink communication, if any; 2> else: 3> set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 as included in the SL-ConfigDedicatedNR received in RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.2, what does the UE do for each PC5 Relay RLC channel that is to be established or modified due to receiving sl-ConfigDedicatedNR?

options.A: Set the SLRB-PC5-ConfigIndex included in the slrb-ConfigToReleaseList.
options.B: Set the SLRB-Config included in the slrb-ConfigToAddModList.
options.C: Set the SL-RLC-ChannelConfig-PC5 included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModList-PC5, according to the received sl-RLC-ChannelConfig.
options.D: Set the sl-MeasConfig according to stored NR sidelink measurement configuration information.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.2, Actions related to transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message
results.evidence: For each PC5 Relay RLC channel that is to be established or modified due to receiving sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, the UE shall: 1> if the sl-RLC-ChannelConfig for this PC5 Relay RLC channel is included: 2> if the corresponding PC5 Relay RLC channel is not established: 3> establish an RLC entity in accordance with the received sl-RLC-Config, applicable for the PC5 Relay RLC channel, as specified in TS 38.322; 3> establish a logical channel in accordance with the received sl-LogicalChannelConfig; 2> if the corresponding PC5 Relay RLC channel is established: 3> reconfigure the RLC entity, associated logical channel in accordance with the received sl-RLC-ChannelConfig; 1> configure the PC5 Relay RLC channel in accordance with the received sl-RLC-ChannelConfig.

results.question: What does TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.2 specify regarding partial success/failure when a UE is unable to comply with part of an RRCReconfiguration configuration?

options.A: The UE applies only the configuration parts it can comply with and ignores the rest
options.B: The UE stores unsupported configuration parts for future use when capabilities improve
options.C: The UE does not apply any part of the configuration - there is no partial success/failure
options.D: The UE applies the configuration but reports non-compliance via measurement reports

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.8.2, Inability to comply with RRCReconfiguration
results.evidence: TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.2 (SRB addition/modification, within the broader RRCReconfiguration / Radio Bearer configuration procedure) reiterates the general RRC principle that reconfiguration is atomic (all-or-nothing): there is no 'partial success' state. If the UE is unable to comply with (part of) the configuration contained in the RRCReconfiguration message (e.g., cannot establish/modify an SRB as specified), the UE shall not apply any part of the corresponding configuration and shall instead perform the actions specified in subclause 5.3.5.5 'Reconfiguration failure'. In practice this means the UE continues using the configuration that was in use prior to the reception of the RRCReconfiguration message and, if AS security has already been activated, initiates the RRC connection re-establishment procedure (5.3.7); if security has not yet been activated, it performs the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11 with release cause 'other'. Thus, failure to comply with even one part of the configuration results in failure of the entire RRCReconfiguration procedure, not a partial application of the successfully configured parts.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.2, what is specified about UE behavior regarding release-16 and later fields in ServingCellConfigCommon that the UE does not support?

options.A: The UE shall reject the entire RRCReconfiguration message
options.B: The UE shall initiate connection re-establishment procedure
options.C: The UE ignores, does not take action on, and does not store unsupported fields
options.D: The UE applies generic error handling and ignores the entire message

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.8.2, Inability to comply with RRCReconfiguration
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the ServingCellConfigCommon configuration included in the received RRCReconfiguration message, ignoring any fields that were introduced in this version of the specification, i.e. any fields introduced in NR Rel-16 or later, that the UE does not support, and shall not consider it as an error.

results.question: Upon receiving a DLInformationTransfer message containing referenceTimeInfo, what must the UE do regarding future SIB9 referenceTimeInfo?

options.A: Continue to monitor and process referenceTimeInfo in SIB9
options.B: Ignore all further referenceTimeInfo received in SIB9
options.C: Fallback to receive referenceTimeInfo in SIB9
options.D: Compare referenceTimeInfo from DLInformationTransfer with SIB9 and use the most recent

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.1.3, Reception of the DLInformationTransfer by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving referenceTimeInfo, the UE shall: 1> if the IE referenceTimeInfo is included in DLInformationTransfer message: 2> use the time and system frame number (SFN) indicated in referenceTimeInfo as the current time and SFN, i.e. the reference time is applicable when it is received; 2> if timeInfoType is included; and 3> consider clause SIB9 in TS 38.331 for future use of uncertainty and reference SFN; 1> if the UE receives referenceTimeInfo in DLInformationTransfer, the UE shall not use the referenceTimeInfo received in SIB9 unless a new SIB9 referenceTimeInfo is broadcast after the reception of the DLInformationTransfer message, i.e. the UE shall disregard/ignore any SIB9 referenceTimeInfo that was received prior to receiving referenceTimeInfo in DLInformationTransfer, and only apply a SIB9 referenceTimeInfo that is received after the dedicated signalling.

results.question: What is the first action a UE must take upon receiving a DLInformationTransfer message?

options.A: Calculate the reference time if referenceTimeInfo is included
options.B: Forward dedicatedNAS-Message to upper layers
options.C: Calculate propagation delay based on UE Rx-Tx measurements
options.D: Check if referenceTimeInfo is included

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.1.3, Reception of the DLInformationTransfer by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving DLInformationTransfer, the UE shall: 1> if the DLInformationTransfer message contains the dedicatedInfoType, and if it is set to dedicatedInfoNAS, forward the dedicatedInfoNAS to the upper layers.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.9.1, which RRC states does the mobility history information procedure cover?

options.A: Only RRC_IDLE and RRC_CONNECTED
options.B: Only RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED
options.C: RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, and RRC_CONNECTED
options.D: Only RRC_CONNECTED

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.9.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall store mobility history information, including cell/RNA/TA identifiers, entry and exit times, and time spent in RRC_CONNECTED, for the last visited cells or RNAs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, and RRC_CONNECTED states.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.6.2, under what condition does the UE initiate the procedure to indicate start of measurement gap activation?

options.A: When upper layers indicate to start performing location measurements towards E-UTRA or NR, and the UE requires measurement gaps while they are either not configured or not sufficient.
options.B: When the UE detects poor signal quality on the serving cell and requires measurement gaps for neighbor cell measurements.
options.C: When the UE is configured with measurement gaps but determines they are not aligned with the target RAT's synchronization signals.
options.D: When the UE receives an RRC reconfiguration message that includes a measGapConfig but the gaps are not yet activated.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.6.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the UE is configured with one or more measurement gaps that are not yet activated and the UE needs to start the activation of the measurement gap(s) as specified in clause 5.5.6.2, initiate the procedure to indicate start of measurement gap activation as specified in 5.5.6.2 upon determining that the measurement gap needs to be activated based on the concerned condition (e.g., the UE requiring the gap to perform measurements as configured by MeasGapConfig, or when the network has configured a pre-configured measurement gap and the UE determines the need to activate it).

results.question: What action does the UE take if preconfigured measurement gaps are configured and at least one meets the requirements when upper layers indicate to start measurements?

options.A: The UE sends an RRC MeasurementReport message to the network.
options.B: The UE triggers lower layers to initiate measurement gap activation request using UL MAC CE.
options.C: The UE autonomously activates the preconfigured gap without network signaling.
options.D: The UE waits for network to send an RRC reconfiguration with activated gaps.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.6.2, Initiation
results.evidence: If preconfigured measurement gaps are configured and at least one of the preconfigured measurement gaps fulfils the requirement in this clause, the UE shall use the preconfigured measurement gap that fulfils the requirement in this clause and apply it as the measurement gap.

results.question: What triggers the UE to deactivate the current active measurement gap when preConfigGapID is activated?

options.A: When the UE successfully completes the location measurement procedure for the target RAT.
options.B: When the UE receives a request from upper layers to transmit a new preConfigGapID or modify current measGapConfig, or if upper layers indicate the current gap is not needed.
options.C: When the UE's serving cell signal quality improves above a threshold, making measurements unnecessary.
options.D: When the UE's battery level falls below a critical threshold, triggering power saving measures.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.6.2, Initiation
results.evidence: Upon activation of a preConfigGapID by MAC, if the UE has an active measurement gap (either previously activated via a preConfigGapID or configured via measGapConfig with a normal gap), the UE shall deactivate/stop the currently active measurement gap and apply the measurement gap pattern associated with the newly activated preConfigGapID.

results.question: Under what condition should a UE initiate transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR to indicate it no longer requires NR sidelink relay discovery announcements resources?

options.A: If the last transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR did not include sl-TxResourceReqListDisc
options.B: If the information carried by sl-TxResourceReqListDisc has changed since the last transmission
options.C: If the last transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR included sl-TxResourceReqListDisc
options.D: If SIB12 includes sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon and U2N Relay UE threshold conditions are met

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message when upper layers indicate that the UE no longer needs NR sidelink relay discovery announcement resources, i.e. upon expiry or cancellation of the relay discovery announcement request from upper layers, in which case the UE includes the SL-RelayUE-Config-r17 or relevant IE with the discovery announcement resource request field set to indicate release/removal of previously requested resources.

results.question: When should a UE acting as a U2N Relay UE initiate transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR to request relay discovery announcements resources?

options.A: If SIB12 includes sl-ConfigCommonNR and the UE has changed PCell
options.B: If the UE is capable of NR sidelink communication and has changed QoS profiles

options.D: If the last transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR included sl-TxResourceReqListDisc

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE acting as a U2N Relay UE shall initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message to request assignment of, or changes to, sidelink discovery resources when the UE is configured to announce relay discovery and needs resources for relay discovery announcement, e.g. upon initiating relay discovery announcement or upon change of relevant configuration/requirements while relay discovery announcement is ongoing.

results.question: At what points in time can MCCH information be changed according to TS 38.331?

options.A: At any radio frame during the repetition period
options.B: Only at specific radio frames defined by the modification period
options.C: Immediately upon network decision, independent of radio frames
options.D: Only during the first transmission of each repetition period

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.1.3, MCCH information validity and notification of changes
results.evidence: MCCH information may only change at specific radio frames, i.e. the concept of a modification period is used. Modification periods are defined by SFN values for which SFN mod (mcch-ModificationPeriod-r17) = 0, and MCCH information can only be changed at such modification period boundaries.

results.question: How does the network notify UEs about an MCCH information change?

options.B: Via PDCCH scheduling the MCCH in every repetition period of the current modification period
options.C: Via a system information block broadcast in every slot
options.D: Via a flag in the MCCH transmission itself

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.1.3, MCCH information validity and notification of changes
results.evidence: When the network changes (some of) the MBS broadcast configuration in MCCH, it may notify the UEs about the change using an MCCH change notification. This notification is sent on PDCCH addressed to MCCH-RNTI, or the network may include a notification bit in Short Message transmitted with P-RNTI over DCI, or the network may indicate MCCH change in the paging message.

results.question: What does the LSB in the 2-bit notification bitmap indicate when set to '1'?

options.B: Modification of MCCH information other than changes caused by new MBS service start
options.C: Immediate acquisition of new MCCH information is required

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.1.3, MCCH information validity and notification of changes
results.evidence: The LSB is used to indicate the paging for the P-RNTI over the MCCH, whereas the second LSB is used to indicate the notification information changes as specified in TS 23.246, TS 26.346, TS 26.347.

results.question: When does a UE apply newly acquired MCCH information after receiving a change notification?

options.B: At the start of the next modification period
options.C: After acquiring the new MCCH information, while applying previous information until then
options.D: After a fixed timer expires following the notification

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.1.3, MCCH information validity and notification of changes
results.evidence: Upon receiving changeNotification, the UE applies the newly acquired MCCH information from the start of the modification period following the one in which the change notification was received, i.e. the UE acquires the updated MCCH information and starts using it from the beginning of the next modification period.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.1, what is the primary purpose of the paging procedure?

options.B: To transmit paging information to a UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.1, General
results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is to send paging information to a UE in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE and to notify UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE as well as RRC_CONNECTED of a system information change and/or an ETWS/CMAS indication and/or to inform a UE in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE as well as RRC_CONNECTED about a PWS notification.

results.question: In which RRC state(s) does a UE need to be to receive paging information via the procedure described in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.1?

options.A: RRC_CONNECTED only
options.B: RRC_IDLE only
options.C: RRC_INACTIVE only
options.D: RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE

results.evidence: The UE receives Paging in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE state.

results.question: What specific information is delivered by the procedure whose purpose is defined in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.1?

options.A: Measurement configuration commands
options.B: Paging information

results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled: Inequality S1-1 (Entering condition): Srxlev > threshold; Inequality S1-2 (Leaving condition): Srxlev < threshold. results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.3, what is the primary purpose of the UE performing measurements?

results.evidence: The UE performs measurements as configured by the network (see subclause 5.5.3) for the purpose of supporting mobility, i.e. to enable the network to evaluate the need for handover, and to trigger the reporting of measurement results by the UE in accordance with the reporting configuration, in order to enable the network to make decisions related to mobility, e.g. cell reselection at handover, addition/release of SCells and SCGs, and other RRM decisions.

results.evidence: The network configures the UE to perform measurements. RRC_CONNECTED: For a UE in RRC_CONNECTED, the network controls UE measurement and reporting behaviour, including measurement configuration (measObjectToAddModList, reportConfigToAddModList, measIdToAddModList), by means of dedicated signalling, i.e. RRCReconfiguration.

results.evidence: The UE shall use the measurement results, as available when the corresponding measurement reporting criteria are fulfilled, to derive the measurement report and shall submit it via the corresponding measurement reporting procedure (i.e. include them in the MeasurementReport message sent to the network), unless otherwise stated in the measurement configuration (e.g. for logged/immediate MDT, where the UE stores the results in VarLogMeasReport for later reporting).

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.5, Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCReject, the UE shall: 1> stop timer T300, T302 and T319 if running; 1> discard any stored UE Inactive AS context and suspendConfig; 1> if the RRCReject was received in response to an RRCSetupRequest or an RRCResumeRequest: 2> if the waitTime is configured in the RRCReject: 3> start timer T302 with the value set to the waitTime; 2> inform upper layers that the RRC connection establishment/resume has failed; 1> if the RRCReject was received in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest: 2> go to RRC_IDLE as specified in clause 5.3.11 with release cause 'RRC connection failure'; 1> the procedure ends.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.4, when a UE processes a measObjectToRemoveList, what action does it take for each measObjectId in the list that matches an entry in its current measObjectList?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.4, Measurement object removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the measId is removed from the measIdList: 2> stop the periodical reporting timer or timer T321, whichever one is running, for this measId; 2> if timer T321 is running for this measId: 3> stop timer T321 for this measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.4, Measurement object removal
results.evidence: When the UE removes a measId from the measIdList, in addition the UE removes, if included, the entry with the matching measId from the VarMeasReportList.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.1.1 Introduction, what is the primary scope of this clause?

results.evidence: This clause describes the RRC procedures i.e. the way UE and network behave upon reception or in absence of a message including error cases e.g. when a message contains a non-comprehensible field. The clause also specifies, in association with each procedure, the purpose of the procedure and the circumstances under which the procedure is invoked, as well as the detailed handling of the message including its contents.

results.question: When including beam measurement information based on SS/PBCH blocks, which beams are included in resultsSSB-Indexes besides the best beam?

results.evidence: resultsSSB-Indexes: The best beam(s) among the beams above threshold, in case beamMeasConfig is present. Only best measured beam(s) are to be reported, in decreasing order of RSRP, RSRQ or SINR, whichever quantity used for ranking, exceeding absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation.

results.question: What determines whether detailed beam measurement results (e.g., RSRP, RSRQ values) are included for each reported beam index?

Specifically, whether RSRP/RSRQ values are included for each reported beam index is determined by the reportQuantity field (e.g., 'ssb-Index-RSRP', 'cri-RSRP') and the associated fields such as includeBeamMeasurements within the ReportConfig or MeasResults/MeasResultServingCell configuration.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.1, which of the following is NOT explicitly listed as a type of SCG failure that triggers the SCGFailureInformation procedure?

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the SCGFailureInformation procedure as defined in TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.1?

results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is to inform E-UTRAN or NR about an SCG failure the UE has experienced i.e. SCG radio link failure, SCG configuration failure, SCG reconfiguration with sync failure, SCG RRC integrity check failure, or exceeding the maximum uplink transmission timing difference for SCG (if configured by network) as well as MBS interest indication and failure information for SL RLF and consistent LBT failure on SCG (when the UE is configured with EN-DC or (NG)EN-DC).

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.14.1, for which entity does the access barring check procedure NOT apply?

results.question: What triggers the UE to perform the access barring check procedure according to clause 5.3.14.1?

results.evidence: 1> for each condConfigId received in the condReconfigToAddModList that is used to add or modify a condRRCReconfig entry, or update entries within the existing configuration, the UE shall: ... 2> if the received condConfigId is already part of the current UE configuration in VarConditionalReconfig; and 3> if the received condReconfigToAddModList includes the condRRCReconfig for this condConfigId: 4> replace the existing condRRCReconfig within the VarConditionalReconfig for this condConfigId with the value received for this condConfigId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.13.3, Conditional reconfiguration addition/modification

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.14.2, when timer T390 is running for a specific Access Category, what action must the UE take upon initiation of the access barring procedure?

options.B: Consider the access attempt as barred
options.C: Select the appropriate UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry
options.D: Perform access barring check using UAC-BarringInfoSet

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.2, Initiation
results.evidence: Upon initiation of the access barring procedure for a specific Access Category, the UE shall: if timer T390 is running for the Access Category concerned: not start the timer T390, i.e. the ongoing access barring for the Access Category continues to apply.

results.question: When SIB1 includes uac-BarringPerPLMN-List containing an entry for the selected PLMN, and the UE has selected a UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry, what does it use for the remainder of the access barring procedure?

options.A: The default barring parameters from SIB1
options.B: The uac-BarringInfoSetList from the previous procedure
options.C: The selected UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry
options.D: The npn-IdentityInfoList parameters

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.2, Initiation
results.evidence: If uac-BarringPerPLMN-List is included and one of its entries in the list is for the selected PLMN (identified by plmn-IdentityIndex), the UE selects this entry for the selected PLMN and uses the corresponding uac-BarringInfoSetList applicable for the selected entry for the remainder of the access barring procedure.

results.question: What action does the UE take if the access barring check was requested by upper layers and the access attempt is considered as barred while timer T302 is running?

options.A: Immediately inform upper layers that access is allowed
options.B: Start timer T390 for the Access Category
options.C: Select a different UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry
options.D: Inform upper layers that the access attempt for the Access Category is barred

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.2, Initiation
results.evidence:
1> if the access barring check is requested by upper layers for an access attempt and the access attempt is considered as barred while T302 is running:
2> if T302 is running:
3> inform the upper layer that access barring is applicable for the access attempt.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.4.3.5, under what condition does a UE store handover failure information in VarRLF-Report when failing to establish a connection to the target RAT?

options.A: When the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra and the UE supports Radio Link Failure Report for Inter-RAT MRO EUTRA
options.B: When voiceFallbackIndication is included in the MobilityFromNRCommand message
options.C: When the UE is unable to comply with any part of the configuration in MobilityFromNRCommand
options.D: When a suitable E-UTRA cell cannot be selected

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.5, Mobility from NR failure
results.evidence: In clause 5.4.3.5 (Mobility from NR failure), the UE shall set the contents of VarRLF-Report and store it (replacing any previous report) only if AS security has been activated; that is, upon failing to establish the connection to the target RAT/system (e.g. due to T304 expiry, inability to comply with the MobilityFromNRCommand configuration, or a protocol error in the inter-RAT information), the UE stores the handover failure information in VarRLF-Report, setting connectionFailureType to 'hof' and previousPCellId etc., provided that AS security had already been activated when the failure occurred; if AS security had not been activated, the UE does not store the VarRLF-Report.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.9.10.4, what action must an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED take upon receiving a NotificationMessageSidelink with indicationType included?

options.A: Maintain the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE
options.B: Initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure
options.C: Perform the PC5-RRC connection release procedure
options.D: Transition to RRC_IDLE state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10.4, Actions related to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving NotificationMessageSidelink message including indicationType, the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall: 1> if the indicationType received in the NotificationMessageSidelink includes rrcReconfiguration: 2> initiate the connection resume procedure or connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.13 or 5.3.7, as applicable, to request the network to provide RRCReconfiguration message including sl-L2RelayUE-Config or other relevant configuration; 1> else if the indicationType received in the NotificationMessageSidelink includes pathSwitch or radioLinkFailure or relayUE-Type: 2> perform relay/remote UE reselection and path switch procedures as specified in clause 5.8.9, if applicable, based on the received indicationType.

results.question: For an L3 U2N Remote UE receiving NotificationMessageSidelink with indicationType included, what does the specification mandate if the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE is determined to be released?

options.A: Initiate RRC connection re-establishment
options.B: Maintain the PC5-RRC connection regardless
options.C: Perform the PC5-RRC connection release procedure
options.D: Transition to RRC_CONNECTED state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10.4, Actions related to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving NotificationMessageSidelink message including indicationType from the U2N Relay UE, if the L3 U2N Remote UE determines that the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE is to be released, the UE shall: 1> release the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE as specified in TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.4; and 1> initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7, if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and has an RRC connection established via the U2N Relay UE.

results.question: What is specified for an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE that receives NotificationMessageSidelink with indicationType included and determines the PC5-RRC connection is NOT released?

options.A: Initiate RRC connection re-establishment
options.B: Perform PC5-RRC connection release
options.C: Maintain the PC5-RRC connection
options.D: Transition to RRC_CONNECTED state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10.4, Actions related to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving a NotificationMessageSidelink message including indicationType, the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE shall: 1> if the UE determines that the PC5-RRC connection is not released: 2> if indicationType is set to networkPaging: 3> proceed as specified in clause 5.3.2.3 (i.e. treat it as if the UE received a Paging message including its identity, and initiate the RRC connection establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.3).

results.question: Upon receiving an RRCRelease message, when does the UE delay the subsequent actions specified in clause 5.3.8.3?

options.A: Immediately upon receipt of the message
options.B: 60 ms from message receipt or when lower layers indicate successful acknowledgment, whichever is later
options.C: 60 ms from message receipt or when lower layers indicate successful acknowledgment, whichever is earlier
options.D: After all timers mentioned in the clause have been stopped

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.3, Reception of the RRCRelease by the UE
results.evidence: The UE shall delay the following actions defined in this sub-clause 60 ms from the moment the RRCRelease message is received or optionally, if included, until the timer T320 expires: - if the AS security is not activated, perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other' upon which the procedure ends; - if AS security is activated, perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other' upon which the procedure ends.

results.question: If AS security is not activated when the UE receives an RRCRelease message, which field in the message must the UE NOT ignore?

options.A: redirectedCarrierInfo
options.B: suspendConfig
options.C: waitTime
options.D: cnType

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.3, Reception of the RRCRelease by the UE
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if AS security has not been activated, ignore all fields in the RRCRelease message except waitTime, and perform the actions as specified in 5.3.8.3, treating the RRCRelease message as if AS security was not activated.

results.question: What action must the UE take regarding timer T316 if it is running when the RRCRelease message is received?

options.A: Restart timer T316 with a default value
options.B: Stop timer T316 and clear any stored VarRLF-Report information
options.C: Continue running timer T316 until expiry
options.D: Stop timer T316 but preserve the VarRLF-Report information

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.3, Reception of the RRCRelease by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCRelease, the UE shall: ... if T316 is running, stop timer T316;

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.2, how does the network initiate the paging procedure?

options.A: By transmitting the Paging message at a random system frame
options.B: By transmitting the Paging message at the UE's paging occasion as specified in TS 38.304
options.C: By transmitting a PagingRecord message directly to each UE
options.D: By broadcasting the Paging message in all synchronization signal blocks

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network initiates the paging procedure by sending the Paging message at the UE's paging occasion (see TS 38.304). In RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE, the UE monitors PDCCH scrambled with P-RNTI for the Paging message according to the paging DRX cycle. The network provides paging information addressed by UE identities (5G-S-TMSI or ng-5G-S-TMSI/full I-RNTI) via the Paging message on the PCCH logical channel to trigger notification for CN paging or RAN paging.

results.question: What specification defines the timing of the UE's paging occasion for the paging procedure initiation in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.2?
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE initiates the paging procedure as specified in TS 38.304 [20] when using RRC_IDLE DRX or in TS 38.213 [13] for paging occasion determination while in RRC_INACTIVE, and the UE monitors for paging in the PO(s) as determined as specified in TS 38.304 [20].

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.2, which statement correctly describes the relationship between Paging message and PagingRecord?

options.A: Each Paging message must contain exactly one PagingRecord
options.B: A PagingRecord is transmitted independently without being contained in a Paging message
options.C: Multiple PagingRecords can be included within a single Paging message to address different UEs
options.D: PagingRecord is an alternative message type to Paging message for initiating paging

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The Paging message is used to inform UEs about system information change, ETWS/CMAS notification and to page the UE for RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state. The Paging message can contain one or more PagingRecord, each of which is associated to a particular UE, identified by ue-Identity within PagingRecord (as specified in clause 6.3.2 for the Paging message). The network initiates the paging procedure by sending the Paging message at the UE's paging occasion. A PagingRecord within the Paging message may be addressed to a UE identified by ng-5G-S-TMSI (for CN-initiated paging) or fullI-RNTI (for RAN-initiated paging when the UE is in RRC_INACTIVE).

results.question: When can the UE append a new entry to VarRA-Report after a successful random-access procedure?

options.A: Only when the number of PLMN entries in plmn-IdentityList is less than maxPLMN
options.B: When the number of RA-Report entries is less than maxRAReport AND (PLMN entries < maxPLMN OR (PLMN entries = maxPLMN AND EPLMNs ⊆ stored plmn-IdentityList))
options.C: Always, unless the procedure was for on-demand system information
options.D: Only when the random-access was performed on an SCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.4, Actions upon successful completion of a random-access procedure or on successful or unsuccessful completion of a procedure for request of on- demand system information
results.evidence: Upon successful completion of the Random Access procedure triggered for reasons other than beam failure recovery, the UE shall, if the Random Access procedure was performed on the PCell, if the RA-ReportConfig received in SIB1 or in RRCReconfiguration includes successBasedReporting, and if the number of entries in VarRA-Report is not equal to maxNrofRA-Report, add a new entry with the RA-Report contents (i.e., set the contents including the cell information, results of the completed procedure, number of preamble transmissions, contention detected, and whether MSGA/MSG3 was used, etc.) at the end of VarRA-Report.

results.question: What does the UE set as spCellId when the random-access procedure was performed on an SCell of SCG?

options.A: The global cell identity of the PCell
options.B: The physical cell identity of the SCell
options.C: The global cell identity of the PSCell
options.D: The tracking area code of the SCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.4, Actions upon successful completion of a random-access procedure or on successful or unsuccessful completion of a procedure for request of on- demand system information
results.evidence:
1> if the random-access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery or SI request:
2> if the random-access procedure was initiated on the SCG, set the content of the RRCReconfigurationComplete message; if the random-access procedure was performed on a Serving Cell of an SCG, the UE sets spCellId to the SCG's PCell (PSCell).

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.6.6, when the UE processes the mrb-ToReleaseList, what action must it take for each mrb-Identity value that is part of the current UE configuration?

options.A: Reset the RLC and MAC entities associated with the PDCP entity
options.B: Release the PDCP entity and the mrb-Identity, and indicate the release to upper layers
options.C: Suspend the PDCP entity and notify the gNB
options.D: Maintain the PDCP entity but release only the RLC configuration

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.6, Multicast MRB release
results.evidence: For each mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration, the UE shall: 1> release the PDCP entity and SDAP entity of this MRB; 1> if PDCP re-establishment or recovery has been triggered for the MRB, abort the ongoing procedure for PDCP re-establishment or PDCP data recovery.

results.question: In the context of multicast MRB release, how does the UE treat an mrb-Identity value in the mrb-ToReleaseList that is NOT part of the current UE configuration?

options.A: The UE considers the message erroneous and discards it
options.B: The UE releases the PDCP entity for that identity anyway
options.C: The UE does not consider the message as erroneous per the note
options.D: The UE requests a reconfiguration from the gNB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.6, Multicast MRB release
results.evidence: The UE shall ignore that entry (i.e., an mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToReleaseList that is not part of the current UE configuration shall be ignored).

results.question: What determines whether the RLC and MAC entities associated with a PDCP entity being released for multicast MRB are reset or released?

options.A: It is always specified in the mrb-ToReleaseList
options.B: It is determined by the CellGroupConfig
options.C: The UE autonomously decides based on traffic conditions
options.D: It is mandated by the PDCP release procedure in all cases

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.6, Multicast MRB release
results.evidence: The RLC entity and the MAC entity are only reset or released if this is the last PDCP entity using this specific RLC and MAC configuration, which depends on whether the RLC bearer(s) associated with the released PDCP entity are shared with other MRBs or DRBs/SRBs still configured for the UE.

results.question: Which of the following functions is explicitly listed in TS 38.331 Clause 4.4 as including the establishment, modification, suspension, resumption, or release of Signaling Radio Bearers (except SRB0)?

options.A: Broadcast of system information
options.B: Initial AS security activation
options.C: Establishment/modification/suspension/resumption/release of RBs carrying user data (DRBs/MRBs)
options.D: Broadcast of system information (item a), specifically information applicable for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 4.4, Functions
results.evidence: RRC connection control: This includes e.g. establishment, modification, suspension, resumption and release of RRC connection, including e.g. establishment/ modification/release of Signalling Radio Bearers (except SRB0)

results.question: As per TS 38.331 Clause 4.4, the RRC function 'Inter-RAT mobility' includes which of the following specific actions?

options.A: Transfer of RRC context information and AS security activation
options.B: Configuration of measurement gaps and reporting
options.C: Change of PSCell and management of SCG cells
options.D: Assignment of ARQ and HARQ configuration

results.evidence: Inter-RAT mobility, including e.g. security activation, transfer of RRC context information

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.13.10, which statement correctly describes the UE's behavior after RRCReject reception?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the message and continue with the current procedure
options.B: The UE shall immediately attempt another RRC connection request
options.C: The UE shall execute procedures defined in another clause (5.3.15)
options.D: The UE shall notify upper layers of the rejection and wait for further instructions

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.10, Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving the RRCReject message in response to an RRCResumeRequest/RRCResumeRequest1, the UE shall: 1> stop timer T319 if running; 2> stop timer T380 if running; 2> reset MAC; 2> release the RRC-Reject-triggered radio bearer configuration (if any); 2> discard the current AS security context; 2> if the RRCReject is received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1, the UE shall: 3> if timer T319 expires: perform the actions as specified for the case T319 expiry (as if the RRC connection resume procedure failed); 2> if the waitTime is configured: 3> start timer T302 with the value set to the waitTime; 2> if the RRC connection resume procedure was triggered due to other than a RNA update: 3> the UE shall, for a period as long as timer T302 is running, consider the cell as barred as specified in 5.3.13.10; 1> go to RRC_IDLE and consider the current cell as barred (as specified in TS 38.304) unless the RRCReject was received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1, in which case the UE remains in RRC_INACTIVE and keeps the stored UE Inactive AS context.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.2.3, what action does the UE take when the upper layer provides a NAS PDU for inclusion in the ULInformationTransfer message?

options.A: It discards the NAS PDU and proceeds with transmission without it.
options.B: It sets the dedicatedNAS-Message to include the information received from upper layers.
options.C: It forwards the NAS PDU directly to lower layers without modification.
options.D: It stores the NAS PDU for later use in a different message.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.3, Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransfer message
results.evidence: The UE shall set the dedicatedNAS-Message to the value provided by the upper layer and submit the ULInformationTransfer message to lower layers for transmission.

results.question: What is the final step the UE performs in the procedure described in TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.2.3 after setting the contents of the ULInformationTransfer message?

options.A: It waits for an acknowledgment from the upper layers.
options.B: It submits the ULInformationTransfer message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
options.C: It verifies the integrity of the message with a checksum.
options.D: It stores a copy of the message for potential retransmission.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.3, Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransfer message
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> submit the ULInformationTransferMRDC message to lower layers for transmission.

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.2.3, which of the following statements accurately describes the UE's action regarding the dedicatedNAS-Message?

options.A: The UE always includes a dedicatedNAS-Message in every ULInformationTransfer.
options.B: The UE includes dedicatedNAS-Message only if the upper layer provides a NAS PDU.
options.C: The UE includes dedicatedNAS-Message only for IAB-MT nodes.
options.D: The UE includes dedicatedNAS-Message after receiving a request from lower layers.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.3, Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransfer message
results.evidence: The UE shall include and send the dedicatedNAS-Message in an UL DCCH message if it is provided by upper layers.

results.question: According to clause 5.2.2.3, what is the primary purpose of the UE acquiring system information from a cell?

options.A: To establish an RRC connection for user data transmission
options.B: To obtain information necessary for the UE to access and operate within the cell
options.C: To report channel quality measurements to the network
options.D: To synchronize the UE's internal clock with the network timing

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE applies the system information acquisition procedure to acquire the AS- and NAS- system information that is broadcast by the network. The procedure applies to UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED. The system information is essential for the UE to know how to operate within the network (e.g., cell selection/reselection, camping, measurement, and access procedures), and the UE needs to acquire this information before it can operate correctly within the network.

results.question: When does a UE initiate the acquisition of system information from a cell, as specified in clause 5.2.2.3?

options.A: Only after receiving an explicit request from the network
options.B: Only when the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.C: When the UE needs to obtain the information contained in the system information
options.D: At regular, network-configured intervals regardless of need

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the system information acquisition procedure as specified in clause 5.2.2.3 upon: 1> selecting a cell (e.g. upon power on); 1> reselecting a cell; 1> returning from out of coverage; 1> after receiving a request from upper layers for on-demand system information as specified in TS 23.122; 1> receiving a notification that the system information has changed; 1> receiving a PAGING message including systemInfoModification; 1> receiving a PAGING message including posSystemInfoModification (for the SI related to positioning); 1> upon exceeding the maximum validity duration of the acquired system information.

results.question: Based on clause 5.2.2.3, which of the following statements is true regarding the UE's acquisition of system information?

options.A: The UE must always acquire all system information blocks from a cell before camping on it.
options.B: The acquisition procedure is only applicable for the UE's serving cell.
options.C: The UE applies the acquired system information according to the specifications for each type of information.
options.D: Acquired system information is stored indefinitely until the UE is powered off.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the system information acquisition procedure described in this clause for acquiring the AS- and NAS- information. This procedure applies to UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED. When in RRC_CONNECTED, in addition, the UE applies the procedure specified in clause 5.2.2.3.2 for acquiring SI messages. The UE shall store the relevant system information acquired from a cell, along with a validity flag indicating whether this information is valid. Requirements to acquire the required MIB, SIB1 and SI messages before accessing the cell (e.g. in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE) or after receiving an indication about system information change are also given.

results.question: What does clause 5.2.2.3 specify about the scope of the 'Acquisition of System Information' procedure?

options.A: It details the specific encoding of each System Information Block (SIB).
options.B: It describes the broadcast scheduling of system information by the network.
options.C: It specifies the UE's actions to acquire system information from a cell.
options.D: It defines the network's response when a UE requests system information.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE applies the system information acquisition procedure to acquire the Access Stratum (AS) and Non-Access Stratum (NAS) information that is broadcast by the network. The procedure applies to UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: When a UE receives a reportConfigToRemoveList containing a reportConfigId that is NOT part of its current VarMeasConfig, how should it treat the message?

options.A: The UE shall consider the message as erroneous and ignore the entire removal procedure.
options.B: The UE shall remove all measId entries from VarMeasConfig as a precautionary measure.
options.C: The UE shall not consider the message as erroneous and proceed with removal only for configured IDs.
options.D: The UE shall initiate a reconfiguration request to synchronize with the network.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each reportConfigId included in the received reportConfigToRemoveList that is not part of the current UE configuration: 2> ignore the received reportConfigId included in reportConfigToRemoveList.

results.question: What is the first action a UE must perform for each reportConfigId in reportConfigToRemoveList that exists in its current VarMeasConfig?

options.A: Stop the periodical reporting timer for all associated measIds.
options.B: Remove the entry with the matching reportConfigId from the reportConfigList in VarMeasConfig.
options.C: Remove all associated measIds from the measIdList in VarMeasConfig.
options.D: Reset the associated information (e.g., timeToTrigger) for each measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: For each reportConfigId included in the reportConfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfig, the UE shall: 1> remove the entry with the matching reportConfigId from the reportConfigList within the VarMeasConfig; 1> for any measId included in the measIdList within VarMeasConfig that is linked to the reportConfigId that is removed from the reportConfigList: 2> remove the entry with the matching measId from the measIdList within the VarMeasConfig.

results.question: If a measId is removed from the measIdList during reporting configuration removal, which of the following actions must the UE take?

options.A: Start a new periodical reporting timer for the next available measId.
options.B: Remove the measurement reporting entry for this measId from VarMeasReportList, if included.
options.C: Add a default reporting entry for this measId to VarMeasReportList.
options.D: Keep the timer T321 or T322 running but reset the associated measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> remove all measId(s) associated with that reportConfigId from the measIdList within the VarMeasConfig; 1> if a measId is removed from the measIdList: 2> remove all measurement reporting entries within the VarMeasReportList for this measId; 2> stop the periodical reporting timer or timer T321, whichever is running, for this measId.

results.question: What action does the UE take immediately upon receiving acknowledgement for an SI request from lower layers?

options.A: Apply the default MAC Cell Group configuration
options.B: Apply the timeAlignmentTimerCommon included in SIB1
options.C: Acquire the requested SI message(s) as defined in clause 5.2.2.3.2
options.D: Initiate transmission of the RRCSystemInfoRequest message

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.3, Request for on demand system information
results.evidence: Upon successful acknowledgement of an SI request by lower layers, the UE shall start timer T100.

results.question: Which of the following configurations does the UE apply when requesting on-demand system information based on RRCSystemInfoRequest with rrcPosSystemInfoRequest?

options.A: Dedicated MAC Cell Group configuration
options.B: CCCH configuration as specified in 9.1.1.2
options.C: All physical layer parameter values from SIB1
options.D: timeAlignmentTimerDedicated from dedicated signaling

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.3, Request for on demand system information
results.evidence: When the UE initiates an RRCSystemInfoRequest containing the rrcPosSystemInfoRequest (i.e., requesting one or more posSIBs), the UE applies the same PRACH/random-access configuration used for the regular on-demand SI request procedure – i.e., the si-RequestConfig (or si-RequestConfigSUL, if configured for a supplementary uplink) broadcast in SIB1 – to determine the RA preamble, PRACH occasion and RA resources used to send the request, as specified in TS 38.331 clause 5.2.2.3.3 'Request for on-demand system information'.

results.question: What does the UE do if cell reselection occurs while waiting for acknowledgement for an SI request based on RRCSystemInfoRequest with rrcPosSystemInfoRequest?

options.A: Continue waiting for the acknowledgement on the new cell
options.B: Release RLC entity for SRB0
options.C: Re-initiate the SI request immediately on the new cell
options.D: Apply the default L1 parameter values from the previous cell

results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled. The UE shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality A1-1 (Entering condition): Ms – Hys > Thresh. Inequality A1-2 (Leaving condition): Ms + Hys < Thresh. The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, without applying any offsets. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event. Ms is expressed in dBm for RSRP, in dB for RSRQ, and in dB for SINR.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2, which of the following statements correctly describes the primary purpose of System Information (SI) in the NG-RAN?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2, System information
results.evidence: System information is divided into the MIB and a number of SIBs, where: the MIB and SIBs contain parameters that enable the UE to acquire the network and access it, e.g. the UE uses the acquired system information to perform cell selection/reselection, and to determine whether/how to access the cell and how to configure lower layers, as well as the physical channel configuration information used for random access to that cell.

results.question: In the context of TS 38.331 Clause 5.2, what is a fundamental characteristic of the System Information (SI) that a cell broadcasts?

options.A: It is unique for each UE and encrypted with the UE's individual security key.
options.B: It is common for all UEs camping on or selecting the cell.
options.C: It is only transmitted upon explicit request from a UE in RRC_CONNECTED state.
options.D: It is identical across all cells within the same Tracking Area.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2, System information
results.evidence: The system information is divided into the MasterInformationBlock (MIB) and a number of SystemInformationBlocks (SIBs). The MIB is always transmitted on the BCCH logical channel mapped to BCH, with a periodicity of 80 ms and repetitions made within 80 ms, and is scheduled statically. SIBs other than SIB1 are carried in SystemInformationBlockType1 (SIB1), which is transmitted on the BCCH mapped to DL-SHCH... All the SIBs other than SIB1 are only broadcast when configured by the network, and may additionally be provided via dedicated signalling. The network may configure indication that a SIB has changed via SI change notification. Furthermore, only SIB1 has a fixed content and periodicity; the other SIBs are broadcast in SI messages, which are transmitted within periodically occurring time domain windows (SI-windows). Each SI message is associated with a SI-window and the SI-windows of different SI messages do not overlap.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.8, what is the primary condition that triggers Event B1 reporting?

results.evidence: Event B1 (Neighbour becomes better than absolute threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled. Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Thresh, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell. Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

results.question: What is the directional relationship described in Event B1 between the inter-RAT neighbor measurement and the threshold?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.8, Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold)
results.evidence: Event B1 (Neighbour becomes better than absolute threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn – Hys > Thresh, and the leaving condition to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn – Hys < Thresh, where Mn is the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets. Thus, Event B1 is triggered when the inter-RAT neighbor cell measurement becomes greater than (better than) the configured absolute threshold.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.7.3, Actions following cell selection while T311 is running

results.question: Under what specific conditions must the UE set the choCellId in the VarRLF-Report when selecting a suitable NR cell while T311 is running?

options.A: Always, for any selected NR cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.7.3, Actions following cell selection while T311 is running
results.evidence: The UE shall set the choCellId in the VarRLF-Report if the connection failure occurs while T311 is running and the UE has selected a suitable NR cell as the cell where re-establishment is attempted, and if the CHO procedure was configured for that cell, i.e. the field is set to indicate the physical cell identity and, if available, the global cell identity of the selected cell if the selected cell corresponds to a candidate cell for which conditionalReconfiguration was configured for CHO by the source cell before the connection failure, and the RRCReestablishmentRequest is subsequently sent to that cell.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.3, what is the primary purpose of Event A2?

options.A: To trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell becomes better than a threshold
options.B: To trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell becomes worse than a threshold
options.C: To trigger measurement reporting when a neighboring cell becomes better than the serving cell
options.D: To trigger measurement reporting when a neighboring cell becomes worse than a threshold

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.3, Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys < Thresh, and shall consider the leaving condition to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys > Thresh, where Mn is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets. Event A2 is primarily used to trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell quality degrades below an absolute threshold, which is commonly used to initiate actions such as triggering inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurements, initiating handover procedures to a better cell, or triggering re-establishment/mobility procedures when the serving cell signal quality becomes worse than an acceptable level.

results.question: In the context of Event A2, what condition must be met for the UE to generate a measurement report?

options.A: Serving cell RSRP becomes greater than a configured threshold
options.B: Serving cell RSRP becomes less than a configured threshold
options.C: Any neighboring cell RSRP becomes greater than the serving cell RSRP
options.D: Serving cell SINR becomes less than a configured threshold

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.3, Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A2-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Ms + Hys < Thresh (Entering condition A2-1), where Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

results.question: What action does the UE take when Event A2 is triggered?

options.A: Initiate cell reselection
options.B: Generate a measurement report
options.C: Switch to idle mode
options.D: Release the RRC connection

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.3, Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate the measurement reporting procedure when Event A2 (Serving cell becomes worse than threshold) is triggered, as configured within the VarMeasConfig, and send a MeasurementReport message to report the measurement results, including the measId, measResultServingMOList, and measResultNeighCells if applicable, in accordance with the reportConfig associated with the measId for which the entry condition applies.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.10.5, when setting ra-InformationCommon, what must the UE set to indicate the absolute frequency of the reference resource block associated with the random-access resources used?

options.A: locationAndBandwidth

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.5, RA information determination for RA report and RLF report
results.evidence: The UE shall set the absoluteFrequencyPointA to indicate the absolute frequency of the reference resource block (Common RB 0) associated with the random-access resources used for the Random Access procedure, as specified in TS 38.211.

results.question: For a 4-step random access attempt on a contention-free resource initiated by PDCCH ordering, when does the UE set dlRSRPAboveThreshold to true?

options.A: If the SS/PBCH block RSRP is above rsrp-ThresholdSSB
options.B: If the SS/PBCH block RSRP is above msgA-RSRP-ThresholdSSB
options.C: Always for PDCCH ordered attempts
options.D: Only if the attempt uses CSI-RS associated resources

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.5, RA information determination for RA report and RLF report
results.evidence: The UE sets dlRSRPAboveThreshold to true if the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference is above the value signalled by rsrp-ThresholdSSB for a 4-step random access type, when random access is initiated by PDCCH order for a contention-free random access resource, if such a resource for the corresponding beam has been explicitly provided by the field ra-PreambleIndex in the PDCCH order and its value is not zero.

results.question: When the random-access resource used is associated to a CSI-RS, what two parameters must the UE set for successive random-access attempts associated with the same CSI-RS?

options.A: csi-RS-Index and msg1-FrequencyStart
options.B: csi-RS-Index and numberOfPreamblesSentOnCSI-RS

options.D: dlRSRPAboveThreshold and locationAndBandwidth

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.5, RA information determination for RA report and RLF report
results.evidence: For successive random-access attempts associated with the same CSI-RS, if the random-access resource used is associated to a CSI-RS, the UE shall set PREAMBLE_RECEIVED_TARGET_POWER to the same value as used for the last transmitted preamble and select the same PRACH occasion as used for the last transmitted preamble.

results.question: Under what condition should a UE in RRC_CONNECTED, configured to transmit NR sidelink discovery messages, use sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection?

options.A: When T310 for MCG or T311 is running and sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-FreqInfoList for the concerned frequency in SIB12
options.B: When the UE is out of coverage on the concerned frequency for NR sidelink discovery
options.C: When the UE is acting as an L3 U2N Relay UE and threshold conditions are met
options.D: When the UE is performing NR sidelink non-relay discovery in coverage

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.13.3, Sidelink discovery transmission
results.evidence: The UE uses random selection with random selection window for sidelink discovery message transmission in resource allocation mode 2 upon initiation of the discovery message transmission and the network has not provided any dedicated sidelink resource allocation, or when the UE is in RRC_IDLE or out of coverage, based on 3GPP TS 38.331, the UE in RRC_CONNECTED configured with sl-DiscConfig and using resource allocation mode 2 shall use random selection when the network has not configured any dedicated sidelink grant or scheduling for discovery message transmission, i.e., when sl-DiscTxResourceReselCounter based selection or sensing-based selection is not applicable/configured, and the UE is configured to select resources autonomously via random selection within the configured sidelink resource pool for discovery.

results.question: What must be true for a UE to transmit NR sidelink discovery messages when it is out of coverage on the concerned frequency?

options.A: The UE must be in RRC_CONNECTED and use the frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR
options.B: The UE must be configured with sl-ScheduledConfig
options.C: The UE must be acting as an L3 U2N Relay UE and meet threshold conditions based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon in SidelinkPreconfigNR
options.D: The frequency must be included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.13.3, Sidelink discovery transmission
results.evidence: The UE is allowed to transmit NR sidelink discovery message(s) if the UE is out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink discovery and the UE has autonomously selected resources for NR sidelink discovery message transmission from a pool of resources configured in sl-DiscConfigOOC (if applicable) or from pre-configured resources included in the sl-DiscConfig within SIB or dedicated signalling, i.e. it has valid configuration for NR sidelink discovery obtained via pre-configuration (sl-PreconfigurationNR) or from a previously received configuration while the UE was in-coverage, and any conditions/authorisation associated with out-of-coverage discovery operation (e.g. applicable RRM parameters/measurement criteria, such as sl-RSRP based cell selection/reselection criteria not being satisfied) are met.

results.question: What resource allocation method should a UE use for NR sidelink discovery transmission when out of coverage and performing non-relay discovery?

options.A: Mode 2 based on random selection using sl-TxPoolExceptional
options.B: Mode 2 based on sensing using pools in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected or sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal in SidelinkPreconfigNR
options.C: Mode 1 scheduled allocation using sl-ScheduledConfig
options.D: Mode 2 based on random selection using pools in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.13.3, Sidelink discovery transmission
results.evidence: If the UE is out of coverage and is performing sidelink discovery message transmission not related to sidelink relay (i.e. neither for U2N relay discovery, U2N remote UE discovery, nor U2U relay discovery), the UE uses resource allocation mode 2 for sidelink discovery message transmission, using SL-PreconfigurationNR (i.e. pre-configured parameters) as specified in TS 38.321 and TS 38.321.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.9.8.2, what must an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE include in the sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE when transmitting a RemoteUEInformationSidelink message?

options.A: ng-5G-S-TMSI only

options.C: ng-5G-S-TMSI and fullI-RNTI
options.D: sl-Requested-SI-List

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.8.2, Actions related to transmission of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
results.evidence: The L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE, upon transmitting the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message as specified in 5.8.9.8.2, shall set the sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE to include the Full I-RNTI in ue-Identity, as included in the most recent Paging message received by the Remote UE, or the ng-5G-S-TMSI, if received by the Remote UE.

results.question: When an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_INACTIVE transmits a RemoteUEInformationSidelink message, how does it determine the UE specific DRX cycle value to set in sl-PagingCycle-RemoteUE?

options.A: Uses the UE specific Uu DRX cycle configured by upper layer
