results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.8.2, Actions related to transmission of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
results.evidence: The UE sets sl-PagingCycle-RemoteUE to the value of UE specific DRX cycle if configured by upper layers, and, in RRC_INACTIVE, includes the RRC_INACTIVE specific DRX cycle if configured; otherwise the UE derives the value from the default DRX cycle broadcast in system information (i.e. it sets sl-PagingCycle-RemoteUE to the shortest of the UE specific DRX cycle, if configured, and the broadcast default DRX cycle).

results.question: Under what condition must an L2 U2N Remote UE include sl-Requested-SI-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message?

options.A: When the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.B: When the UE has not stored a valid version of one or several required SIB(s)
options.C: When the UE is configured with a fullI-RNTI
options.D: When the UE specific DRX cycle changes

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.8.2, Actions related to transmission of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
results.evidence: The L2 U2N Remote UE shall set sl-Requested-SI-List to include the SIB(s) that triggered the request, if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message is being sent to report that the UE requires one or more SIBs (other than SIB1) that are not currently broadcast by the U2N Relay UE, upon receiving a request from upper layers to acquire such SI, or if the concerned SI validity has expired, in accordance with the SI acquisition procedure.

results.question: A UE is configured for NR sidelink discovery monitoring via RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync (handover). It has both sl-DiscRxPool and sl-RxPool configured for NR sidelink discovery reception in the RRCReconfiguration message. According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.13.2, which resource pool should the UE configure its lower layers to use for monitoring?

options.A: The resource pool indicated by sl-RxPool.
options.B: The resource pool indicated by sl-DiscRxPool.
options.C: The UE should use a preconfigured resource pool from SL-PreconfigurationNR.
options.D: The UE should not monitor as both pools are present, causing a conflict.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.13.2, Sidelink discovery monitoring
results.evidence: If sl-DiscRxPool is configured in sldiscConfig within the RRCReconfiguration message received for handover (i.e. with reconfigurationWithSync) and sl-RxPool is also configured for NR sidelink discovery reception, the UE shall configure the lower layers to use sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery monitoring.

results.question: For a UE in coverage and configured to monitor NR sidelink discovery, if the chosen cell provides SIB12 and SIB12 contains sl-RxPool for NR sidelink but NOT sl-DiscRxPool, what action does TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.13.2 specify?

results.evidence: If SIB12 is provided by the chosen cell and includes sl-RxPool but not sl-DiscRxPool, the UE shall use the sl-RxPool included in SIB12 for monitoring NR sidelink discovery.

results.question: When a UE receives an RRCReject message in response to an RRCSetupRequest, what action must it take regarding upper layers?

results.question: Which of the following timers must the UE stop upon reception of RRCReject, according to the clause?
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.15.2, Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCReject, the UE shall: 1> stop timer T300, if running; 1> stop timer T302, if running; 1> stop timer T319, if running; 1> stop timer T321, if running; 1> discard any stored cell reselection priority information provided by dedicated signalling; 1> reset MAC and release the default MAC cell group configuration, if any; 1> perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with the release cause 'RRC connection failure', upon which the procedure ends.

results.question: What must an RRC_INACTIVE UE do regarding paging while timer T302 is running after receiving RRCReject?

options.A: Stop monitoring paging
options.B: Continue to monitor paging
options.C: Monitor paging only if T331 is running
options.D: Monitor paging only for access categories 0 and 2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.15.2, Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCReject while attempting to resume from RRC_INACTIVE, the UE shall start timer T302 with the value set to the waitTime included in the RRCReject message, and while T302 is running the UE shall not consider itself barred from receiving paging: it continues to monitor the paging channel (using its configured DRX cycle) and process any paging messages received, even though initiation of new RRC connection establishment/resume attempts (except for specific exceptions such as emergency calls, mobile terminated data or configured exceptions) remains barred until T302 expires or is stopped.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.1, which of the following is a purpose of the SidelinkUEInformationNR procedure when a UE is involved in NR sidelink unicast communication?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.1, General SIB12 acquisition SidelinkUEInformationNR
results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is for a UE to: (i) indicate its interest in receiving or continuing to receive SL communication/discovery; (ii) provide relevant configuration information; and (iii) indicate its interest in NR sidelink communication or discovery reception with unicast, groupcast, or broadcast, including reporting of a list of destinations for which the UE has data to transmit via sidelink, along with the associated PC5 QoS information required for sidelink DRB establishment/reconfiguration for unicast, and to report the failure of PC5-RRC connection for unicast when the RLF or PC5-S protocol error occurs.

results.question: Which of the following scenarios specifically triggers the SidelinkUEInformationNR procedure for a TX UE operating with resource allocation mode 1, as per TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.1?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.1, General SIB12 acquisition SidelinkUEInformationNR
results.evidence: The TX UE, upon transitioning from RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_CONNECTED, or upon becoming interested to transmit sidelink communication/discovery while configured with sl-TxPoolExceptional or resource allocation mode 1, shall trigger the procedure specified in this clause to indicate its sidelink communication/discovery transmission resource needs to the network, e.g., upon initiating NR sidelink communication/discovery transmission requiring network scheduling (mode 1), so that the network can provide dedicated sidelink grant/configuration via RRCReconfiguration.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the IAB Other Information procedure as defined in TS 38.331?

options.A: To request the IAB-donor-CU to allocate an IP address for the collocated IAB-DU

results.question: What are the two possible actions performed through the IAB Other Information procedure?

results.question: Which network element is the recipient of the IAB Other Information message?

options.A: IAB-MT

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.5.2, when executing a reconfiguration with sync for the MCG and timer T316 is running, what must the UE do?

results.question: Which of the following is a prerequisite for initiating the Mobility from NR procedure?

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.23, what is the primary scope of UE requirements related to SIB21?

results.question: What does TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.23 state about UE requirements for SIB21 contents beyond referenced specifications?

options.B: No UE requirements apply other than those specified elsewhere

results.evidence: The UE is only required to comprehend and act upon the fields and values of SIB21 as explicitly specified in TS 38.331. Even though SIB21 content may be based on, or reference, information defined in other specifications, the UE is not required to support, interpret, or apply any additional fields, parameters, or semantics beyond what is explicitly captured within TS 38.331 itself. The network shall not assume that the UE understands or acts on content defined only in the externally referenced specification but not reproduced or explicitly mandated in TS 38.331.

results.question: How does the clause characterize UE obligations regarding SIB21 processing?

options.A: UE must independently interpret all SIB21 parameters
options.B: UE requirements are limited to referenced specifications and procedures
options.C: UE must acknowledge receipt of SIB21 to the network

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.23, Actions upon reception of SIB21
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the SL-related parameters provided by the sidelink-specific system information block SIB21, if broadcast by the network, upon acquiring or receiving it, and shall use it for NR sidelink communication/discovery as long as the SIB21 remains valid, in accordance with the SI acquisition procedures specified in clause 5.2.2; the UE is not required to acquire SIB21 unless it supports and intends to use NR sidelink communication/discovery.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.3.1, what is the primary purpose of the RRC connection establishment procedure?

options.B: To establish SRB1 and transfer initial NAS dedicated information from UE to network

results.question: In which scenario does the network apply the RRC connection establishment procedure when a UE is resuming or re-establishing an RRC connection?

options.A: When the network successfully retrieves and verifies the UE context

results.evidence: The network applies the procedure as follows: ... when an RRC connection could not be resumed or re-established due to network reject, network not responding to RRC resume or re-establishment request, or due to other error cases (e.g., in case of security check failure while resuming/re-establishing an RRC connection), the network applies the RRC connection establishment procedure when the RRCSetup message is used to fallback the ongoing RRC connection resume or RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

results.question: For NR sidelink communication, when is an RRC connection establishment initiated according to condition 2 in clause 5.3.3.1a?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.1, General
results.evidence: 2> if configured to receive/transmit NR sidelink communication and the UE is in RRC_IDLE and upperlayer requests NR sidelink communication transmission for which sl-TxDirectCurrentList in SIB is not broadcast, or the UE has no valid version of the required SIB

results.question: What measurement relationship does Event A3 evaluate?

options.A: Comparison between two neighbour cells
options.B: Comparison between neighbour cell and serving cell with an offset

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
results.evidence: Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell): Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets. Mp is the measurement result of the PCell/PSCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell. Ofp is the frequency specific offset of the primary frequency (i.e. the frequency of the PCell/PSCell). Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell. Ocp is the cell specific offset of the PCell/PSCell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Off is the offset parameter for this event.

results.question: Which of the following best describes the 'offset' component in Event A3?

options.A: A fixed value defined by network standards
options.B: A configurable parameter applied to the comparison
options.C: The difference between two neighbour cells
options.D: The hysteresis value for event triggering

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
results.evidence: a3-Offset: This field is used in Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell). The offset value used in the event formula is contained in this field, expressed as a threshold... The offset is used to introduce hysteresis-like margin so that the neighbour cell measurement (Mn) must exceed the serving cell measurement (Mp) by more than this offset (after applying Ofn, Ocn, Ofp, Ocp and Hys) before the entering condition Inequality A3-1 is satisfied, and must fall below it by more than the offset before the leaving condition Inequality A3-2 is satisfied.

results.question: In the context of Event X2, what does the 'threshold' refer to?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.18, Event X2 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition X2-1 is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition X2-2 is fulfilled, where: Inequality X2-1 (Entering condition): Ml – Hys < Thresh; Inequality X2-2 (Leaving condition): Ml + Hys > Thresh; The variable Thresh in the formula is expressed in dB. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. thresholdCSI-RS-cellSFTD for event X2, or in general the threshold field configured within the reportConfig associated with the measId for this event), and Ml is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets.

results.question: Which of the following best describes the primary condition evaluated for Event X2 reporting?

options.D: Expiry of a timer associated with the relay UE connection

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.18, Event X2 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331 does not define a measurement event named 'Event X2'; the standard NR measurement events are A1–A6 (intra-RAT) and B1–B2 (inter-RAT). If 'Event X2' is intended as a generic/placeholder reference, the primary condition it would most closely resemble—based on the naming convention and typical use of 'X2'-style entering conditions in measurement event design—is analogous to Event A2: the entering condition is satisfied when the serving cell's measured quality (RSRP, RSRQ, or SINR) becomes worse than an absolute threshold, i.e., Ms + Hys < Thresh, triggering a measurement report to indicate degraded serving cell quality.

results.question: In TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.5, when the UE provides random access problem indication from SCG MAC and the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery, what failureType value is set?

options.B: randomAccessProblem
options.C: other
options.D: rlc-MaxNumRetx

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.3.5, Actions related to transmission of SCGFailureInformation message
results.evidence: Upon receiving random access problem indication from SCG MAC, or upon indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached, or upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from SCG MAC while T304 is not running, the UE shall: 1> initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.5 to report SCG radio link failure, if the connection to the SCG is considered failed, i.e. if one of the following conditions is met: 2> set the failureType to beamFailureRecoverySCG upon random access problem indication from SCG MAC and the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery, as specified in TS 38.321 [3].

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.5, when does the UE set the failedPSCellId field in the SCGFailureInformation message?

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3, which condition must be met for a UE to consider a frequency as part of the MBS frequencies of interest?

options.A: The UE must be currently receiving the MBS session via a broadcast MRB on that frequency.
options.B: The UE must have acquired SIB21 from any cell that includes MBS FSAIs for that frequency.
options.C: At least one MBS session the UE is receiving or interested to receive via a broadcast MRB is ongoing or about to start.
options.D: The UE must verify that the session is indicated on MCCH for the concerned frequency.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE shall consider a frequency as one of the MBS frequencies of interest if the UE is interested to receive an ongoing or a future MBS broadcast service, indicated by upper layers via the MBS interest indication, on that frequency, i.e. the frequency provides or would provide access to the concerned MBS broadcast service(s), the frequency is included in the SIB providing MBS broadcast service configuration, and the UE would camp on that frequency according to the cell reselection rules were it in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.

results.question: What information source does the UE use to determine if an MBS session is ongoing or about to start, as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: The MCCH indication on the serving cell
options.B: The start and stop time indicated in the User Service Description (USD)
options.C: The MBS FSAIs included in SIB21
options.D: The UE's current serving frequency configuration

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE uses the MBS session information broadcast in the system information (specifically the information contained in SIB20/MBS-related system information, such as MBS neighbouring cell information and MBS session information) to determine if an MBS session identified by a TMGI is ongoing or about to start.

results.question: When evaluating UE capability for simultaneous reception of broadcast MRBs on MBS frequencies of interest, what does the UE NOT take into account according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: The MBS frequencies it is interested to receive
options.B: The supportedBandCombination included in UE-NR-Capability
options.C: The serving frequencies that it is currently configured with
options.D: The MBS FSAIs indicated in the USD for the session

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE does not take into account other MRBs configured/being received via multicast MRBs, other RRC configuration in relation to signalling or unicast bearers, or capabilities related to unicast (e.g. bandwidth combination sets), when evaluating its capability to receive broadcast MRBs simultaneously on MBS frequency(ies) of interest.

results.question: Under what condition regarding SIB21 must be satisfied for a frequency to be considered part of MBS frequencies of interest per TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: SIB21 acquired from any cell must include MBS FSAIs for the concerned frequency
options.B: SIB21 acquired from the PCell must include one or more MBS FSAIs as indicated in the USD for at least one MBS session
options.C: SIB21 must indicate that the session is currently being broadcast on MCCH for the concerned frequency
options.D: SIB21 must be acquired from a cell operating on the concerned frequency

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: A frequency is regarded as an MBS frequency of interest only if the cell on that frequency broadcasts SIB21 and the SIB21 contains scheduling information (e.g., an MBS-BroadcastServiceInfo/TMGI entry) matching at least one MBS broadcast service that the UE is interested in receiving.

results.question: When a UE receives a ConditionalReconfiguration IE containing condReconfigToRemoveList, what action must it perform?

options.A: Initiate conditional reconfiguration addition procedure
options.B: Perform conditional reconfiguration removal procedure
options.C: Evaluate execution conditions for all candidate cells
options.D: Apply the conditional reconfiguration immediately

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.13.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall perform the conditional reconfiguration removal as follows: 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the condReconfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration: 2> remove the entry with the matching condReconfigId from the VarConditionalReconfig, if any.

results.question: What triggers a UE to apply conditional reconfiguration according to the general principles in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.13.1?

options.A: When the network sends an explicit activation command
options.B: When any configured candidate target SpCell becomes available
options.C: When a target SpCell fulfills its associated execution condition
options.D: When the primary SpCell signal quality drops below threshold

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.13.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall apply a conditional reconfiguration, i.e. execute the stored RRCReconfiguration associated with a candidate cell, when the execution condition(s) configured for that candidate cell (condExecutionCond, e.g. one or two measurement-based trigger conditions such as CondEvent A3/A4/A5) are satisfied based on the UE's RRM measurement evaluation while the UE remains in RRC_CONNECTED, and the UE shall thereafter stop evaluating and consider all other conditional reconfigurations for that condRRCReconfigId as expired.

results.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a ConditionalReconfiguration IE containing condReconfigToAddModList?

options.A: Remove all existing conditional reconfigurations
options.B: Ignore the IE if conditions are not yet met
options.C: Perform conditional reconfiguration addition/modification
options.D: Immediately execute handover to the first candidate cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.13.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the received condReconfigToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration: 2> if the received CondReconfigToAddMod contains condRRCReconfig that includes the field nonCriticalExtension or in case of the RRCReconfiguration message within condRRCReconfig containing a masterCellGroup or secondaryCellGroup with fullConfig: 3> perform the actions upon reception of RRCReconfiguration as specified accordingly, considering it as part of the conditional reconfiguration; 2> store the condRRCReconfig within the VarConditionalReconfig associated to this condReconfigId; 2> store the condExecutionCond associated to this condReconfigId; 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the received condReconfigToAddModList that is part of the current UE configuration: 2> replace the condRRCReconfig for this condReconfigId with the value received for condRRCReconfig, if received; 2> replace the condExecutionCond for this condReconfigId with the value received for condExecutionCond, if received.

results.question: What type of mobility control is specified for the inter-RAT scenarios described in TS 38.331 Clause 5.4.1 Introduction?

results.evidence: The E-UTRA the UE moves to can be connected to Evolved Packet Core (EPC) or 5GC.

results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if sl-MeasConfig received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes sl-QuantityConfig: 2> store the sl-QuantityConfig in accordance with received sl-QuantityConfig.

results.question: What action must the UE take when barring is considered alleviated for an Access Category that was previously informed to upper layers as barred?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.3, Void
results.evidence: The UE shall inform the upper layer that access barring is alleviated for the corresponding Access Category, if the UE is configured to report barring alleviation for that Access Category, when the barring is considered alleviated for an Access Category which was informed to upper layers as barred.

results.question: For which Access Categories does the UE need to perform actions specified in 5.3.13.8 when barring is alleviated?

options.A: Access Categories '2' and '8' only

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.8, under what condition must the UE use the received values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 as the current values?

results.evidence: The UE shall use the received values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 as the current messageIdentifier and serialNumber only if this is the first SIB7 received by the UE after entering the current cell, or if the messageIdentifier and/or serialNumber received in the current SIB7 differ from the messageIdentifier and serialNumber values previously stored by the UE for SIB7 in that cell (i.e. the received SIB7 is not a duplicate of a previously received and stored ETWS secondary notification).

results.question: What must the UE do immediately after using received messageIdentifier and serialNumber as current values upon receiving SIB7, according to the specified actions?

results.evidence: The UE shall use the values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber received in the SIB7 as the current values and, immediately after the transmission of the ETWS primary notification, if the ETWS primary notification was received within an RRC connection, or immediately after receiving the SIB7, the UE shall forward the received warningType and, if included, the emergencyUserAlert and popupOnDisplay to upper layers.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.14.2, NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the thresholds to be met for relay/remote operation as follows: 1> if configured with thresholds and RSRP is measured; 1> the UE stays in a state where the conditions are met as long as the serving cell RSRP remains within the configured thresholds. The UE considers the thresholds not to be met (leave) if the measured RSRP value of the serving cell used for evaluating sidelink relay/remote operation becomes worse than (or better than, depending on the direction of the threshold) the configured threshold value (e.g., sl-Thresh-RSRP-Relay or sl-Thresh-RSRP-Remote) for a duration exceeding the configured hysteresis/time-to-trigger, i.e., when the RSRP condition that previously indicated 'in coverage/threshold met' no longer holds, causing the UE to exit the relay/remote eligible state.

results.question: What is the primary action a UE must take upon receiving a MasterInformationBlockSidelink message according to TS 38.331?

options.A: Store the message for future reference
options.B: Apply the values included in the received message
options.C: Forward the message to neighboring UEs
options.D: Compare the values with previous configurations

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.4.2, Actions related to reception of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving MasterInformationBlockSidelink, the UE shall: 1> apply the values included in sl-TDD-Configuration for the concerned SL communication and/or discovery, if present; 2> if the field inCoverage is included, indicate to upper layers that the UE transmitting the MasterInformationBlockSidelink is in coverage; 3> use the timing information contained in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink to derive the SFN and subframe/slot number for sidelink operation, in order to determine the synchronization reference for sidelink communication and/or discovery.

results.question: Which of the following describes the UE's mandatory behavior when MasterInformationBlockSidelink is received?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the message if values conflict with current configuration
options.B: The UE shall apply the received values regardless of current state
options.C: The UE shall request updated values from the network
options.D: The UE shall broadcast the message to other sidelink UEs

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.4.2, Actions related to reception of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving MasterInformationBlockSidelink for a given SL-BWP, the UE shall: 1> use the received DFN (directFrameNumber-r16) and slot index (slotIndex-r16) to derive the timing reference for sidelink transmission/reception on the concerned SL-BWP; 1> apply the received sl-TDD-ConfigCommon-r16 to determine the sidelink TDD resource configuration for the SL-BWP; 1> if inCoverage-r16 is included, consider itself to be in coverage of NR on the concerned frequency; if not included, consider itself to be out of coverage; 1> store the acquired MasterInformationBlockSidelink parameters and use them until a new MasterInformationBlockSidelink with different content is received from the same source, or the SL-BWP is released/reselected.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the procedure described in TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.6.1?

options.A: To enable a UE to request network resources for sidelink communication
options.B: To inform a peer UE of sidelink DRX assistance information for unicast communication
options.C: To configure sidelink DRX parameters for broadcast communication
options.D: To report sidelink channel measurements to the gNB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.1, General
results.evidence: Clause 5.8.9.6.1 (General) of TS 38.331 specifies the general procedure by which a UE, having acquired the necessary MBS broadcast configuration (e.g., via MCCH/MBSBroadcastConfiguration or SIB-based signalling), establishes and maintains an MRB for MTCH reception in order to receive MBS broadcast service data. Its primary purpose is to define how the UE applies the broadcast MRB configuration and monitors/receives the associated MTCH so that it can receive the user-plane data of an MBS broadcast session without a unicast RRC connection dedicated to that service, ensuring the UE stays synchronized with the network's MBS broadcast configuration and can start, continue, or stop reception as configured.

results.question: How does a UE provide its desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast communication according to this clause?

options.A: By including it in an RRCReconfigurationComplete message sent to the gNB
options.B: By transmitting it in the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink to its peer UE
options.C: By embedding it in the SIB message for sidelink configuration
options.D: By reporting it in a MeasurementReport message to the network

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.1, General
results.evidence: The UE may indicate its desired SL DRX configuration for unicast by including the sl-DRX-ConfigRequest (or equivalent SL-DRX-Config request IE) within the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message and transmitting it to the peer UE over the PC5 interface as part of the PC5-RRC signalling procedure for sidelink DRX configuration/reconfiguration.

results.question: According to the NOTE in this clause, what determines a UE's desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast?

options.A: It is mandated by network configuration from the gNB
options.B: It is standardized and fixed in the 3GPP specification
options.C: It is up to UE implementation
options.D: It is negotiated between the UE and the core network

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.1, General
results.evidence: NOTE: What determines the UE's desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast is up to UE implementation, e.g. based on the QoS profile(s) of the sidelink DRB(s) and/or SL signalling radio bearer(s), it wants to set up or has already set up with the peer UE.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.10, when a UE receives SIB9 with referenceTimeInfo, what is specified about its behavior?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the referenceTimeInfo
options.B: The UE may perform actions defined in another clause
options.C: The UE must store the information for future handovers
options.D: The UE shall immediately stop all other procedures

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.10, Actions upon reception of SIB9
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB9 including referenceTimeInfo, the UE shall: 1> if the IE referenceTimeInfo is included, and if the UE supports the corresponding capability (uplinkTimingAdvance or similar), use the received time value and the associated uncertainty as specified in TS 38.133 to synchronize its clock with the network reference time; 1> the UE shall consider the time indicated in referenceTimeInfo to be valid at the SFN boundary at or immediately after the ending boundary of the SI-window in which SIB9 is received; 1> if the referenceTimeInfo received via SIB9 was also provided via dedicated signalling (e.g. in RRCReconfiguration) after the last cell (re)selection, the UE shall use the most recently received value, irrespective of whether it was received via SIB9 or dedicated signalling.

results.evidence: Clause 5.2.2.4.6 (Actions upon reception of SIB5) specifies that a UE operating in standalone (SA) mode shall be capable of acquiring and applying the full contents of SIB5 independently, i.e. without reliance on any E-UTRA anchor carrier or NSA-specific assistance information. Specifically, the UE shall apply the SIB5 contents – including the inter-frequency neighbouring cell list, cell reselection parameters common to inter-frequency cells (e.g. threshold values, offsets, timers), inter-frequency carrier frequency information, and any blacklisted/whitelisted cell lists – to perform cell reselection towards inter-frequency NR cells as specified in TS 38.304. results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.1.2, AS Security
results.evidence: As specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.1.2 (AS security), SRB1 may be used prior to the activation of AS security to transfer certain RRC messages (e.g. RRCSetup, RRCReject, RRCReestablishment, RRCReestablishmentReject) without ciphering and integrity protection. Once AS security has been activated, all subsequent messages on SRB1 are both ciphered and integrity protected. SRB2 and SRB3, when configured, are used only after AS security has been activated, and messages sent on these SRBs are always both ciphered and integrity protected. SRB0 is never protected by AS security.

results.question: What determines the 5-bit BEARER parameter value provided by RRC to lower layers for SRB ciphering and integrity protection?

results.evidence: The bearer identity used in the derivation of the 5-bit BEARER parameter for SRBs is the Radio Bearer identity as specified in TS 33.501, i.e., for SRBs, the value is set based on the SRB identity (with SRB1 mapped to a fixed value distinct from DRB identities), and lower layers use this BEARER value together with COUNT, KEY, DIRECTION and LENGTH as input to the ciphering and integrity protection algorithms.

results.evidence: If NIA0 is used, it shall be used only for SRBs and for DRBs that are not required to be integrity protected. results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.12, what condition triggers Event C2?

options.B: The NR sidelink channel busy ratio falls below a configured threshold

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.12, Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)
results.evidence: Event C2 (CSI-RS resource becomes offset better than reference CSI-RS resource): entering condition C2-1: Mn – Hys > Ms + Off; leaving condition C2-2: Mn + Hys < Ms + Off. Mn is the measurement result of the CSI-RS resource, not taking into account any offsets. Ms is the measurement result of the reference CSI-RS resource, not taking into account any offsets. Off is the offset parameter for this event (i.e. csi-rs-OffsetC2 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Mn and Ms are expressed in dB. The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-1 is fulfilled and the leaving condition to be satisfied when condition C2-2 is fulfilled.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.12, Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality C2-1 (Entering condition): NR sidelink channel busy ratio measurement result of the serving frequency is greater than a threshold. Inequality C2-2 (Leaving condition): NR sidelink channel busy ratio measurement result of the serving frequency is less than a threshold.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.7, what is the primary condition that triggers Event A6 reporting?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.7, Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell)
results.evidence: Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A6-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A6-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality A6-1 (Entering condition): Mn + Ocn – Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off. Inequality A6-2 (Leaving condition): Mn + Ocn + Hys < Ms + Ocs + Off. Where: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ocn is the offset of the neighbouring cell, and set to zero if not configured for the neighbouring cell. Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell on the SCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ocs is the offset of the serving cell (SCell) and set to zero if not configured. Off is the offset parameter for this event, i.e. a6-Offset as defined within reportConfigNR for this event. Mn, Ms are expressed in dB. Ocn, Ocs, Hys, Off are expressed in dB.

results.question: In the context of Event A6, what specific relationship between cells triggers the UE to send a measurement report?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.7, Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell)
results.evidence: Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell): Entering condition: Mn + Ocn – Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off; Leaving condition: Mn + Ocn + Hys < Ms + Ocs + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, Ms is the measurement result of the SCell, Ocn is the offset of the neighbouring cell, Ocs is the offset of the SCell, and Off is the offset parameter for this event, as defined in TS 38.331. The UE shall send a measurement report when a neighbouring cell becomes offset better than the SCell by more than a configured offset (Off), meaning the neighbour cell's measured quality exceeds the SCell's measured quality (including respective cell individual offsets) by the Off value, accounting for hysteresis.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.19, what triggers Event Y1?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.19, Event Y1 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and candidate L2 U2N
results.evidence: Event Y1 (Quality of the Uu link between the L2 U2N Relay UE and the network becomes better than a threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition Y1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition Y1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality Y1-1 (Entering condition): Ms – Hys > Thresh. Inequality Y1-2 (Leaving condition): Ms + Hys < Thresh. Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell of the L2 U2N Relay UE, not taking into account any offsets. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. threshY1 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Ms is expressed in dBm for RSRP, in dB for RSRQ and in dB for SINR. This event is used by the Remote UE to evaluate whether the serving link quality (Uu) of the L2 U2N Relay UE it uses is good enough, e.g., for triggering path switching from sidelink relay path to the direct Uu path or for relay (re)selection purposes.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.19, Event Y1 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and candidate L2 U2N
results.evidence: Event Y1 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold, and candidate L2 U2N Relay UE becomes better than threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when both condition Y1-1 and condition Y1-2, as specified below, are met, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when either condition Y1-3 or condition Y1-4, as specified below, is met. Condition Y1-2: A candidate relay UE's relay discovery RSRP becomes better than a threshold (i.e., Thresh2).

results.question: What is the role of the candidate in Event Y1 as defined in TS 38.331?

options.A: Any neighboring gNB
options.B: A candidate L2 U2N Relay UE
options.C: Any L3 relay node
options.D: A candidate SCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.19, Event Y1 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and candidate L2 U2N
results.evidence: Event Y1: Serving cell becomes better than absolute threshold. The 'candidate' in this context refers to a candidate PSCell or candidate cell that the UE evaluates for a potential mobility action (such as SCG addition/change or conditional handover), and reporting/triggering of Event Y1 relates to the serving cell measurement crossing a threshold, not directly a 'candidate' role in the traditional sense—candidates are relevant in Conditional Handover/Conditional PSCell Change execution conditions where Event Y1 can be configured as one of the trigger conditions for a candidate cell to become eligible for execution.

results.question: When setting the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell for SS/PBCH block-based measurements, how does the UE order the available measurement quantities?

options.A: In chronological order of measurement collection

options.D: Ordered by physical cell ID in ascending order

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.5, RLF report content determination
results.evidence: For the field rsIndexResults included in measResultLastServCell, if SS/PBCH block based measurement quantities are available, the UE shall order the measured results such that RSRP is included first, followed by RSRQ, followed by SINR, in accordance with the availability of the corresponding measurement quantities as configured by reportQuantityRsIndexes.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE set the timeSinceCHO-Reconfig in the RLF report?

options.A: Always when a handover failure occurs
options.B: When configuration of conditional handover is available in VarConditionalReconfig at the moment of declaring RLF
options.C: Only when the failure type is randomAccessProblem
options.D: When the UE has stored neighbor cell measurements

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.5, RLF report content determination
results.evidence: The UE sets the timeSinceCHO-Reconfig to the time that elapsed since the reception of the last CHO configuration (i.e. the reconfiguration used for CHO execution) until the connection failure, if a CHO configuration for the CHO candidate cell for which the CHO execution condition was met was received.

results.question: When may the UE discard the radio link failure information stored in VarRLF-Report?

options.A: Immediately after successfully reconnecting to the network
options.B: 24 hours after the failure is detected
options.C: 48 hours after the radio link failure/handover failure is detected
options.D: After transmitting the RLF report to the network

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.5, RLF report content determination
results.evidence: The UE shall discard the radio link failure information stored in VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the information to the network as indicated by RRC, or if the UE has stored the radio link failure information for the period defined in section 5 of TS 38.331 (i.e., 48 hours after detection of the radio link failure or upon power off), whichever is earlier.

results.question: What specific type of messages does this procedure enable the UE to receive and transmit?

options.A: NR sidelink discovery messages
options.B: RRC connection reconfiguration messages
options.C: NAS authentication messages

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.14.1, General
results.evidence: This procedure enables the UE to receive and transmit dedicated signalling messages, i.e. RRC messages, in RRC_CONNECTED as well as in RRC_INACTIVE state where applicable.

results.question: What triggers the need for a UE to reacquire system information blocks (SIBs) other than SIB1, as specified in clause 5.2.2.2?

options.A: Whenever the UE performs a TAU (Tracking Area Update) procedure
options.B: When the UE detects a change in the systemInformationAreaID broadcast in SIB1
options.C: When the UE transitions from RRC_IDLE to RRC_INACTIVE state
options.D: When the UE's serving cell RSRP drops below -110 dBm

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2, SIB validity and need to (re)-acquire SIB
results.evidence: The UE shall re-acquire the SIBs other than SIB1 either when it receives a systemInfoValueTag in SIB1 that is different from the value stored by the UE (in which case only those SIBs whose value tag has changed need to be re-acquired), or when the validity duration of the stored SIBs expires, or when the UE has changed serving cell or received a notification of change of system information via short message, or when the UE has returned to the network coverage after a period of not having a valid version of SIB1, or when the UE has become part of a network from another network (e.g., after PLMN reselection), or the UE requires an acquisition of relevant SIBs based on request from upper layers or other requirements not related to reception of paging indication (e.g. request from other RATs, ANDSF, etc.).

results.question: According to clause 5.2.2.2, when a UE camps on a new cell, what determines whether stored system information from a previous cell can be considered valid?

options.A: Stored SI is always invalid when camping on a new cell and must be reacquired
options.B: Stored SI may be valid if the new cell broadcasts the same systemInformationAreaID as the previous cell
options.C: Stored SI is valid if the new cell belongs to the same gNB as the previous cell
options.D: Stored SI remains valid for 24 hours regardless of cell changes

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2, SIB validity and need to (re)-acquire SIB
results.evidence: The UE may use stored SI in a valid version received from the current or a previous camping cell as long as the criteria to consider the SI to be valid, as specified in clause 5.2.2.5, are fulfilled.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.8.3, what action must the UE take when T331 expires or is stopped?

options.A: Initiate a new measurement configuration request to the network
options.B: Release the VarMeasIdleConfig
options.C: Continue idle/inactive measurements according to SIB2 and SIB3 configurations
options.D: Switch to connected mode measurement procedures

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.3, T331 expiry or stop
results.evidence: Upon expiry or stopping of T331, the UE shall: 1> stop measurement reporting; 1> if the UE is configured for SL positioning: 2> stop SL positioning reference signal transmission/reception; 1> discard the associated measurement configuration provided by the sl-PositioningConditionalReconfig/measConfig; 1> perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.4 (Cell selection leading to selection of an inter-frequency cell not among the frequencies configured for measurements) if applicable; 1> release the measurement configuration associated with T331; 1> consider the UE Positioning procedure to be completed unsuccessfully.

results.question: What does the NOTE in TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.8.3 specify regarding UE behavior after T331 has expired or stopped?

options.A: The UE must stop all idle/inactive measurements immediately
options.B: UE implementation decides whether to continue measurements per SIB11/SIB4 or E-UTRA SIB5/SIB24 configurations upon inter-RAT reselection to E-UTRA
options.C: The UE must always use SIB11 and SIB4 configurations for all subsequent measurements
options.D: The network will provide explicit reconfiguration instructions via RRC signaling

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.3, T331 expiry or stop
results.evidence: NOTE: After T331 expires or is stopped, the UE behaviour to segregate/discard the measurement results collected during the whole/part of the logging duration is left to UE implementation.

results.question: Under what condition does Clause 5.7.8.3 mandate the release of VarMeasIdleConfig?

options.A: When the UE enters RRC_CONNECTED state
options.B: When T331 expires or is stopped
options.C: Upon reception of a new measurement configuration from the network
options.D: When the UE performs intra-frequency cell reselection

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.3, T331 expiry or stop
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCRelease without measIdleConfig, or upon receiving RRCRelease with measIdleConfig but the UE not supporting measurement configuration idle mode measurements, or upon entering RRC_CONNECTED, or upon receiving RRCReconfiguration including measIdleConfig with the field measIdleDuration set to release, or upon expiry of T331, the UE shall discard the VarMeasIdleConfig.

results.question: How may a UE determine whether an MBS session is ongoing, as noted in TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.4?

options.A: By monitoring the MBS control channel for session status indicators
options.B: From the start and stop time indicated in the User Service Description (USD)
options.C: By receiving explicit RRC signaling from the gNB about session state
options.D: Through periodic polling of the MBS service announcement function

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.4, MBS services of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE may determine that an MBS session is ongoing based on the reception of MRB configuration information for that MBS session (e.g. TMGI and/or session ID) provided within the MBSBroadcastConfiguration message on MCCH, and/or based on upper-layer indications (e.g. from the MBS User Service Description) that the associated MBS session has started; conversely, the UE considers the session as not ongoing when it no longer finds a corresponding MRB configuration for that TMGI/session ID in the received MCCH information, or receives an explicit indication that the session has stopped.

results.question: For an MBS service to be considered part of the MBS services of interest, where must the MBS FSAI(s) be included?

options.A: In the UE's stored preference list for MBS services
options.B: In SIB21 acquired from any cell on the current frequency
options.C: In SIB21 acquired from the PCell for a frequency belonging to the set of MBS frequencies of interest
options.D: In the MBS session announcement received via MCCH

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.4, MBS services of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE considers an MBS service to be part of the MBS services of interest if the MBS FSAI(s) associated with the MBS service are included in the MBS Frequency Selection Priority List (mbsfsaiList) broadcast in SIB or provided via dedicated signalling, and are included in the list of MBS FSAI(s) that the UE has interest in receiving, as configured/provided by upper layers.

results.question: Which of the following correctly describes the UE's reception interest condition for an MBS service to be considered of interest?

options.A: The UE must be currently receiving the service via a unicast MRB
options.B: The UE must be receiving or interested to receive the service via a broadcast MRB
options.C: The UE must have previously received the service via any MRB type
options.D: The UE must be configured to receive the service via a multicast MRB only

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.4, MBS services of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE considers an MBS service to be of interest if the UE is receiving or interested in receiving the associated MBS service via broadcast or multicast, and upper layers indicate reception interest in this MBS service.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.4.3, when a UE initiates transmission of UEAssistanceInformation to provide a delay budget report, how should it set the delayBudgetReport field?

options.A: Set delayBudgetReport to type1 according to a desired value
options.B: Set delayBudgetReport to type2 according to network configuration
options.C: Set delayBudgetReport to type3 based on current QoS requirements
options.D: Omit the delayBudgetReport field entirely

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.4.3, Actions related to transmission of UEAssistanceInformation message
results.evidence: The UE shall set the delayBudgetReport to signal the recommended change of the value 1/(1+0.5) for connected mode DRX cycle length: if the UE prefers a smaller value for the connected mode DRX cycle length than currently configured, or the currently configured value 1/(1+0.5) is a step change, the UE sets delayBudgetReport with type value 'decrease16' or 'decrease' as specified in TS 38.331; if the UE prefers a larger value for the connected mode DRX cycle length than currently configured, the UE sets delayBudgetReport with type value 'increase16' or 'increase'; the UE includes the delayBudgetReport within UEAssistanceInformation message and submits it to lower layers for transmission upon initiating the procedure as specified in clause 5.7.4.3 of TS 38.331.

results.question: When a UE experiences internal overheating and prefers to temporarily reduce the number of maximum secondary component carriers, which IE must be included in the OverheatingAssistance according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.4.3?

options.A: reducedMaxCCs
options.B: reducedMaxBW-FR1
options.C: reducedMaxMIMO-LayersFR1
options.D: reducedMaxMIMO-LayersFR2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.4.3, Actions related to transmission of UEAssistanceInformation message
results.evidence: The IE reducedAggregatedBandwidth shall be included if the UE prefers to temporarily reduce the number of configured secondary component carriers or MR-DC secondary cells due to internal overheating condition.

results.question: If a UE experiencing internal overheating prefers to temporarily reduce maximum aggregated bandwidth of FR1, which two parameters must be set according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.4.3?

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.3.2, what is the initial value F₀ set to when the first physical layer measurement result M₁ is received?

options.A: F₀ is set to 0
options.B: F₀ is set to M₁
options.C: F₀ is calculated using the formula with a default filter coefficient
options.D: F₀ is set to the maximum possible measurement value

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.3.2, Layer 3 filtering
results.evidence: The UE shall set an internal variable Fn initially, when the first measurement result from the physical layer is received after the reception of the update of measurement configuration by upper layers, i.e. F0 = M1, where F0 is the initial value.

results.question: For which measurement type does the UE have implementation freedom to decide whether to reset filtering upon BWP switch?

options.B: CLI-RSSI measurements
options.C: Sidelink RSRQ measurements
options.D: UTRA-FDD Ec/No measurements

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.3.2, Layer 3 filtering
results.evidence: For CLI measurements, the UE may or may not apply layer 3 filtering upon BWP switching, i.e. it is left up to UE implementation whether to reset the filter.

results.question: What does the filter coefficient k = 0 indicate about Layer 3 filtering according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.3.2?

options.A: Maximum filtering is applied
options.B: Filtering uses a default coefficient of 4
options.C: No layer 3 filtering is applicable
options.D: Filtering is performed only in linear domain

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.3.2, Layer 3 filtering
results.evidence: If k is set to 0, no layer 3 filtering is applicable (in this case the measurements are not filtered by the layer 3 filter specified in this clause), and F(n) = M(n), i.e. the output of the layer 1 filter is used directly as the input to the evaluation of reporting criteria and/or for measurement reporting.

results.question: What is a potential consequence for the UE's access to the current PCell as a result of executing the procedure in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.9.1?

options.A: Access is guaranteed to be maintained
options.B: Access may be temporarily enhanced
options.C: Access may be barred
options.D: Access is automatically transferred to a new PCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.9.1, General
results.evidence: The UE applies the parameters of the received mobilityControlInfo/reconfigurationWithSync and, if the procedure fails or cannot be applied, the UE may lose access to the current PCell, i.e., the RRC connection reconfiguration with synchronisation (handover) procedure specified in clause 5.3.9.1 may result in the UE being unable to access the current PCell.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.15.1, under what condition does the UE initiate the procedure upon receiving RRCReject?

options.A: When the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state

options.C: When the UE receives an RRCRelease message
options.D: When the UE successfully completes random access

results.evidence: The UE initiates the procedure to release the RRC connection upon receiving RRCReject while establishing the RRC connection, i.e. in RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state performing RRC connection establishment or RRC connection resume, as specified in clause 5.3.15.1.

results.question: What triggers the UE to initiate the procedure described in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.15.1?

options.A: Reception of RRCReject when access is barred during RRC establishment/resume attempt
options.B: Reception of RRCReconfiguration
options.C: Expiry of T300 timer
options.D: Successful RRC connection setup

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.15.1, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE initiates the procedure described in clause 5.3.15 to indicate to the network the NR sidelink communication related information, when in RRC_CONNECTED, upon any of the following: 1> if the UE has an active request from upper layer to transmit or receive NR sidelink communication; 1> upon changing to a PCell that broadcasts SIB related to NR sidelink communication and the UE has NR sidelink communication information to report; 1> if the UE has a change in the NR sidelink communication information to be reported; 1> upon successful establishment or resumption of the RRC connection; 1> if the UE has relay related information to report as a NR sidelink relay UE or NR sidelink remote UE.

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.15.1, when does the UE initiate the procedure upon RRCReject reception?

options.A: Whenever RRCReject is received, regardless of context
options.B: Only during RRC connection release
options.C: When access attempt is barred during RRC establishment or resume
options.D: When the UE is in idle mode

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.15.1, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE initiates the procedure when the network sends RRCReject in response to RRCSetupRequest, RRCResumeRequest, RRCResumeRequest1, or RRCReestablishmentRequest.

results.question: What action does the UE take regarding the VarMeasReportListSL and sl-MeasIdList when the sl-ReportType is set to sl-Periodical?

options.D: Starts the periodical reporting timer but does not modify VarMeasReportListSL

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.4.2.3, for cases other than when the UE is connected to 5GC of the source E-UTRA cell during intra-system inter-RAT handover, how is the source RAT configuration considered?

options.A: It is fully transferred to the target RAT configuration
options.B: It is partially considered based on delta configuration
options.C: It is not considered when applying the reconfiguration message of target RAT
options.D: It overrides the target RAT configuration for common parameters

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.2.3, Reception of the RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.evidence: For cases other than the intra-system inter-RAT handover from NR to E-UTRA/5GC, the source RAT configuration for measurements is considered released upon successful completion of the intra-system inter-RAT handover.

results.question: For a UE in RRC_IDLE configured with an eDRX cycle longer than the modification period, how are the boundaries of the eDRX acquisition period determined?

options.A: By SFN values where SFN mod 1024 = 0
options.B: By H-SFN values where H-SFN mod 1024 = 0
options.C: By the start of each modification period
options.D: By the UE's paging occasion within each DRX cycle

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2.2, SI change indication and PWS notification
results.evidence: For a UE configured with an eDRX cycle longer than the modification period, the eDRX acquisition period is used instead of the normal modification period for acquiring changed system information via paging. The boundaries of the eDRX acquisition period are aligned with the eDRX cycle boundaries, i.e. they coincide with the boundaries of the eDRX cycle (SFN satisfying SFN mod (eDRX cycle length in radio frames) = 0), such that the eDRX acquisition period starts at the beginning of an eDRX cycle that also coincides with a modification period boundary, and its duration equals the length of one eDRX cycle.

results.question: Under what condition must a UE in RRC_CONNECTED monitor for SI change indication at least once per modification period?

options.A: Always, regardless of search space configuration
options.B: Only when T319a is not running
options.C: If provided with common search space on the active BWP to monitor paging
options.D: Only when configured with an eDRX cycle longer than the modification period

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2.2, SI change indication and PWS notification
results.evidence: The UE while in RRC_CONNECTED shall monitor for SI change indication or acquire the SI message repetitions in every modification period at least once, if configured with a DRX cycle longer than the modification period.

results.question: When is the SI change indication not applicable according to the clause?

options.A: For SI messages containing posSIBs
options.B: For UEs in RRC_INACTIVE while T319a is running
options.C: For UEs using an eDRX cycle shorter than the modification period
options.D: For PWS notifications transmitted via Short Message

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2.2, SI change indication and PWS notification
results.evidence: The SI change indication in Short Message is not applicable for BL UEs or UEs in CE, or for NB-IoT.

results.question: What action should a UE configured with an RRC_IDLE eDRX cycle longer than the modification period take if the systemInfoModification-eDRX bit of Short Message is set?

options.A: Immediately re-acquire SIB1
options.B: Apply the SI acquisition procedure from the start of the next modification period
options.C: Apply the SI acquisition procedure from the start of the next eDRX acquisition period boundary
options.D: Acquire SIB6, SIB7, or SIB8 immediately if capable

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2.2, SI change indication and PWS notification
results.evidence: Upon receiving Short Message with systemInfoModification-eDRX bit set, if the UE has an RRC_IDLE eDRX cycle longer than the modification period, and if the UE supports eDRX in RRC_IDLE, the UE shall reacquire the system information after each paging occasion at which the systemInfoModification-eDRX bit was received, in accordance with clause 5.2.2.3.2.

results.question: When the UE processes an sl-MeasId from sl-MeasIdToAddModList and no matching entry exists in sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL, what is the required action per TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.10.2.3?

options.A: Ignore the sl-MeasId since no matching entry exists
options.B: Create a placeholder entry and wait for further configuration
options.C: Add a new entry for this sl-MeasId within VarMeasConfigSL
options.D: Remove the sl-MeasId from sl-MeasIdToAddModList

results.evidence: 1> if there is no entry with the matching sl-measId in the sl-measIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL: 2> create a new entry within the sl-measIdList that includes the received sl-measId, sl-measObjectId and sl-reportConfigId contained within the sl-measIdToAddModList;

results.question: While timer T310 is running for the SpCell, what specific condition triggers the UE to stop both timers T310 and T312?

options.A: Upon receiving N310 consecutive 'out-of-sync' indications
options.B: Upon receiving N311 consecutive 'in-sync' indications
options.C: Upon the expiry of timer T310
options.D: Upon receiving a single 'in-sync' indication after any 'out-of-sync'

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.2, Recovery of physical layer problems
results.evidence: Upon receiving N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers while T310 is running, the UE shall stop timer T310; stop timer T312 if running.

results.question: According to the recovery procedure, what is the consequence for the RRC connection when the UE stops T310 due to receiving N311 consecutive 'in-sync' indications?

options.A: The UE initiates an RRC connection re-establishment procedure.
options.B: The UE releases the entire radio resource configuration and enters RRC_IDLE.
options.C: The UE maintains the RRC connection without explicit signalling, keeping the radio resource configuration.
options.D: The UE sends an explicit RRC reconfiguration message to the network to confirm recovery.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.2, Recovery of physical layer problems
results.evidence: Upon stopping of timer T310, if the UE stops timer T310 as specified above before the expiry of the associated timer T310, the UE shall: continue with the RRC connection, i.e. the connection is considered to be recovered and no RRC re-establishment or connection release is triggered as a result of the radio link failure detection that was in progress.

results.question: How do periods where neither 'in-sync' nor 'out-of-sync' is reported by layer 1 affect the evaluation of consecutive indications for recovery?

options.A: They reset the count of consecutive indications.
options.B: They are treated as 'out-of-sync' indications for the purpose of the count.
options.C: They do not affect the evaluation of the number of consecutive indications.
options.D: They pause the timers T310 and T312 until the next indication is received.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.2, Recovery of physical layer problems
results.evidence: Upon receiving N313 consecutive 'out-of-sync' indications for the SpCell from lower layers while T310 is not running, the UE shall start timer T310... Upon receiving N314 consecutive 'in-sync' indications for the SpCell from lower layers while T310 is running, the UE shall stop timer T310. If neither 'in-sync' nor 'out-of-sync' is reported by layer 1 during a certain period, this period does not count as consecutive 'in-sync' or consecutive 'out-of-sync' indications, i.e. any period without reporting does not reset the counter of consecutive 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' indications, but it also does not contribute to reaching N313 or N314.

results.question: Under what condition must a UE in RRC_CONNECTED acquire the MIB according to clause 5.2.2.3.1?

options.A: When the UE has an active BWP with common search space configured by searchSpaceSIB1
options.B: When T311 is running
options.C: When the UE has received an indication about change of system information
options.D: When the UE has not stored a valid version of a required SIB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.1, Acquisition of MIB and SIB1
results.evidence: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall apply the MIB acquisition procedure specified in clause 5.2.2.3.1 to acquire the MIB of the PCell only if the UE needs to acquire the timing information (SFN) of that cell, e.g. upon receiving an RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync (handover/PCell change) or upon selecting/reselecting that cell, unless the UE already has a valid stored version of the MIB for that cell.

results.question: When is a UE in RRC_CONNECTED required to acquire SIB1, assuming SIB1 is transmitted in the cell and SIB1 acquisition is required?

options.A: Always, regardless of unicast data reception
options.B: Only if the UE has not stored a valid version of a required SIB and si-BroadcastStatus is set to broadcasting
options.C: Only if the UE can acquire it without disrupting unicast or MBS multicast data reception

results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the DRB is associated with an SDAP entity: 2> if release of the SDAP entity is required, indicate to upper layers that the SDAP entity is released.

results.question: Upon receiving the UuMessageTransferSidelink message, what is the first procedure the L2 U2N Remote UE shall perform according to clause 5.8.9.9.3?

options.A: Perform the procedure defined in clause 5.3.2.3
options.B: Perform the actions specified in clause 5.2.2.4
