options.D: Forward the message to the gNB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.9.3, Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink
results.evidence: Upon receiving the UuMessageTransferSidelink message, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall: 1> perform the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7.

results.question: After performing the procedure in clause 5.3.2.3 upon UuMessageTransferSidelink reception, what must the L2 U2N Remote UE do next?

options.A: Discard the message
options.B: Perform the actions in clause 5.2.2.4
options.C: Send a confirmation to the network
options.D: Enter RRC_IDLE state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.9.3, Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink
results.evidence: Upon receiving the UuMessageTransfer message via sidelink, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall perform the procedure in clause 5.3.2.3, and after having performed the procedure in clause 5.3.2.3, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall discard any stored UE Inactive AS context.

results.question: Which UE type is specified as the receiver of the UuMessageTransferSidelink message in clause 5.8.9.9.3?

options.A: L1 U2N Remote UE
options.B: L2 U2N Remote UE
options.C: L3 U2N Relay UE
options.D: Any sidelink-capable UE

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.9.3, Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink
results.evidence: The UuMessageTransferSidelink message is used by the target UE to transfer the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message to the source UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.9.3 (UuMessageTransferSidelink). The receiving UE for this message is the source UE.

results.question: What triggers the actions specified in clause 5.8.9.9.3 for the L2 U2N Remote UE?

options.A: Receiving any RRC message
options.B: Receiving the UuMessageTransferSidelink message
options.C: Establishing a PC5 connection
options.D: Detecting radio link failure

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.9.3, Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink
results.evidence: Upon receiving an RRCReconfiguration message including the sl-L2RemoteUE-Config with the mobilityInfo, the L2 U2N Remote UE performs actions specified in clause 5.8.9.9.3 to complete the path switch to the target relay UE or target network.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.8.2, under what condition can the network initiate an RRC connection release to transition a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE?

options.A: Only if SRB1 is established
options.B: Only if SRB2 and at least one DRB, multicast MRB, or (for IAB) SRB2 is setup
options.C: Only if the UE is in poor radio conditions
options.D: Only if the UE has uplink data pending

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network initiates an RRC connection release to RRC_INACTIVE only if AS context of the UE is available in the network, i.e., only for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED for which the UE's AS context has been established, and the network can retrieve the UE context for the concerned UE (e.g. based on I-RNTI) if the UE is to send an RRCResumeRequest message to resume the connection or to send an RRCResumeRequest message to perform an RNA update.

results.question: According to clause 5.8.9.8, what is the primary purpose of the Remote UE information element?

options.A: To provide the Remote UE's security credentials to the network
options.B: To enable the Relay UE to forward information about the Remote UE to the gNB
options.C: To configure the Remote UE's radio bearers directly from the gNB
options.D: To establish a direct RRC connection between the Remote UE and the gNB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.8, Remote UE information
results.evidence: The Remote UE information element is used to provide the identity of the Remote UE and, when applicable, the ProSe Relay UE, to convey information to the network for U2N (UE-to-Network) relay operation, such as during sidelink relay establishment, so that the network can identify and correlate the Remote UE with its serving relay UE for handling of sidelink relay related procedures.

results.question: According to the note in the clause, what is left to UE implementation regarding T380 expiration?

options.A: Behavior when T380 expires while camped on a suitable cell
options.B: Behavior when T380 expires while camped on an acceptable cell
options.C: Behavior when T380 expires while camped neither on suitable nor acceptable cell
options.D: Behavior when T380 expires during RNA Update procedure

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.8, RNA update
results.evidence: When T380 expires, the UE initiates the registration area updating procedure as specified in TS 23.502. NOTE: The exact action to be taken when T380 expires, e.g. immediately triggering the RRC connection re-establishment procedure or waiting until the next transition to RRC_CONNECTED, is left to UE implementation.

results.question: When the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest, what action does the UE take regarding its established radio bearers?

options.A: Reconfigure all established RBs according to the new masterCellGroup.
options.B: Maintain all established RBs and their associated entities.
options.C: Release radio resources for all established RBs except SRB0, including RLC and PDCP entities.
options.D: Suspend radio resources for all established RBs except SRB0 until configuration is complete.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: 1> if the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest or RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1: 2> release the radio resources for all established RBs; 2> release the RRC configuration; 2> perform the actions as specified in 5.3.11;

results.question: Under what condition should a UE include 'rlf-InfoAvailable' in the RRCSetupComplete message?

options.A: If the UE has experienced any radio link failure during its operation.
options.B: If the UE has radio link failure information stored, is capable of cross-RAT RLF reporting, and the RPLMN is in the stored plmn-IdentityList.
options.C: If the UE is configured for RLF reporting by the network in SIB2.
options.D: If the UE has an active RLF report and is in RRC_CONNECTED state.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: The UE shall include rlf-InfoAvailable in RRCSetupComplete if the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report, i.e., available since the last time the UE compiled the RLF report as specified in 5.3.10.5.

results.question: What must the UE do with application layer measurement reports that were not yet transmitted when receiving RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest?

options.A: Buffer them for transmission after the RRCSetupComplete is sent.
options.B: Forward them to the new cell via the RRCSetupComplete message.
options.C: Discard any application layer measurement reports which were not transmitted yet.
options.D: Include them in the VarMobilityHistoryReport for future use.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1 (i.e. fallback to RRC connection establishment), the UE shall discard any application layer measurement reports that have not yet been submitted to lower layers for transmission, in addition to discarding the stored UE Inactive AS context and any current AS security context, releasing the RRC configuration except for the parts indicated as exceptions, and stopping timer T319 if running.

results.question: According to Note 4 in Clause 5.2.2.3.2, under what condition may a UE in RRC_CONNECTED stop PDCCH monitoring during the SI window for a concerned SI message?

options.A: When the UE enters RRC_IDLE state
options.B: When the requested SIB(s) are acquired
options.C: When searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation is set to zero
options.D: When the SI window overlaps with UL symbols

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.evidence: NOTE 4: The UE in RRC_CONNECTED state may stop receiving the concerned SI message after successfully receiving one instance of the SI message, i.e. it may stop PDCCH monitoring for the SI message within the SI-window once it has successfully received that SI message.

results.question: What does the specification state regarding a UE's requirement to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions corresponding to each transmitted SSB in the SI window?

options.A: The UE must monitor PDCCH for all transmitted SSBs in the SI window
options.B: The UE is not required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasion(s) corresponding to each transmitted SSB in SI-window
options.C: The UE must monitor only the PDCCH occasions corresponding to the strongest SSB
options.D: The UE must monitor PDCCH for at least half of the transmitted SSBs

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.evidence: The UE is required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions for scheduling of the SI message within the associated SI-window. The UE shall monitor PDCCH monitoring occasion(s) corresponding to each transmitted SSB in the SI-window, i.e. the UE is not required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions that do not overlap with, or correspond to, a transmitted SSB. For each transmitted SSB, at least one PDCCH monitoring occasion for the SI message shall be provided within the SI-window, and the UE may assume that the same SI message content is transmitted in all such monitoring occasions corresponding to different transmitted SSBs within that SI-window.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.3, which of the following is a valid trigger for a UE to initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message?

options.A: To report to the network that a sidelink radio link failure has been declared
options.B: To request configuration of NR sidelink positioning reference signal resources
options.C: To report the UE's location information for sidelink operation
options.D: To indicate the UE's preferred bandwidth part for sidelink communication

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message in the following cases: upon change of any of the parameters relevant for sidelink communication (e.g. upon change of sidelink communication interest, upon change of a related traffic pattern, upon change to the required RB, upon change of destinations, upon change of QoS parameters, etc.), or upon successful completion of a handover procedure, or upon successful completion of an RRC re-establishment or resume procedure, or upon request from upper layers to transmit sidelink communication and no destinations were previously configured or upon request from upper layers to change or add sidelink discovery information, or upon change of the parameters relevant for sidelink discovery, or upon a request from upper layers to stop sidelink communication/discovery for a certain destination, or upon change of NR sidelink communication/discovery related capability, or upon entering or leaving a frequency configured for NR sidelink communication/discovery.

results.question: For NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission, what should the UE include in sl-QoS-InfoList?

options.A: QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer
options.B: QoS profile(s) of all configured sidelink QoS flows regardless of destination
options.C: The default QoS profile for U2N relay communication
options.D: QoS profile(s) received from the peer UE in UECapabilityInformationSidelink

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.evidence: The UE shall include, in the sl-QoS-InfoList, the PC5 QoS parameters (e.g., PQI, and if applicable, the associated PC5 QoS flow related parameters such as GFBR/MFBR, and the sl-QoS-FlowIdentity) for each PC5 QoS flow associated with the sidelink relay communication that is being requested/reported, for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission.

results.question: When a UE detects sidelink radio link failure for a specific destination, what action must it take regarding the sidelink-specific MAC entity?

options.A: Reconfigure the sidelink-specific MAC with default parameters
options.B: Suspend the sidelink-specific MAC operations
options.C: Reset the sidelink specific MAC of this destination
options.D: Report the MAC status to the network via Uu interface

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.evidence: Upon detecting sidelink radio link failure for a destination, the UE shall: reset the sidelink-specific MAC for that destination.

results.question: Which of the following indications from lower layers would trigger sidelink radio link failure detection according to clause 5.8.9.3?

options.A: Indication from sidelink RLC that maximum number of retransmissions has been reached for a specific destination
options.B: Indication from PHY layer about poor sidelink channel quality
options.C: Indication from RRC layer about PC5-RRC connection timeout
options.D: Indication from NAS layer about authentication failure

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.evidence: Upon receiving MAC layer indication of maximum number of consecutive DTX above sl-dtx-ThresholdConsecutiveDTX-r17 or receiving PDCP indication that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached for a PC5-RRC signalling radio bearer (SRB) or upon indication from lower layers that random access problem has been detected for the SL, the UE shall consider sidelink radio link failure to be detected for the corresponding SL-RLC-BearerConfig or PC5-RRC connection.

results.question: Which of the following actions is performed by the UE for ALL MobilityFromNRCommand receptions, regardless of targetRAT-Type?

options.A: Consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards E-UTRA
options.B: Access the target cell according to target RAT specifications
options.C: Forward nas-SecurityParamFromNR to upper layers
options.D: Stop timer T390 for specific access categories only

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving MobilityFromNRCommand, the UE shall stop timer T310, if running, for the corresponding SpCell, irrespective of the value of the targetRAT-Type included in the message.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.19, what must a UE do upon receiving a segment of SIB17 if it has stored at least one previous segment and detects that the value tag has changed since storing that previous segment?

options.A: Store the new segment and continue assembling with previous segments
options.B: Discard all stored segments before storing the new segment
options.C: Ignore the new segment and keep the previously stored segments
options.D: Immediately attempt to assemble SIB17-IEs with available segments

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.19, Actions upon reception of SIB17
results.evidence: The UE shall discard any stored segments for SIB17 and store this new segment as the first segment of a new SIB17 message, if the value tag received in the current segment differs from the value tag of the previously stored segment(s) for SIB17.

results.question: In which RRC state can the ULInformationTransfer procedure be used to transfer F1-C related information for IAB operation?

options.A: RRC IDLE
options.B: RRC INACTIVE
options.C: RRC CONNECTED
options.D: Any RRC state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer NAS or non-3GPP dedicated information as well as F1-C related information for IAB from the UE to network, or, upon indication from upper layers, only to transfer the UE's request for reduced data usage. If AS security has not been activated, the UE does not initiate the procedure. This procedure is only used when the UE has an RRC connection, i.e. in RRC_CONNECTED, and, in case of NB-IoT, if the UE supports the ULInformationTransfer procedure in RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.3, when the network modifies an existing measId via measIdToAddModList, what is the UE's first action regarding the VarMeasConfig?

options.A: Add a new entry for this measId within the VarMeasConfig
options.B: Replace the existing entry with the value received for this measId
options.C: Remove the measurement reporting entry for this measId from the VarMeasReportList
options.D: Stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.3, Measurement identity addition/modification
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each measId included in the received measIdToAddModList that is already contained in the measIdList within VarMeasConfig: 2> remove the entry for this measId from the measIdList within VarMeasConfig; 2> add a new entry for this measId within VarMeasConfig, replacing the one that was removed.

results.question: When the reportType is set to reportCGI for an NR FR1 measurement object and useAutonomousGaps is included, what timer value does the UE set for T321?

options.A: 1 second
options.B: 2 seconds
options.C: 5 seconds
options.D: 16 seconds

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.3, Measurement identity addition/modification
results.evidence: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall: ... 1> if the useAutonomousGaps is included and it is set to true and the reportType is set to reportCGI and the measObject is associated with NR: 2> set the timer T321 to 1000 ms;

results.question: What must the network ensure before configuring a measId according to the measurement identity addition/modification procedure?

options.A: The corresponding measurement object and reporting configuration are configured
options.B: The corresponding measurement object, reporting configuration, and quantity configuration are configured
options.C: The corresponding measurement object and quantity configuration are configured
options.D: The corresponding reporting configuration and quantity configuration are configured

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.3, Measurement identity addition/modification
results.evidence: The network should ensure that, for each measId to be added or modified, the corresponding measObjectId and reportConfigId (i.e. the measurement object and reporting configuration referenced by that measId) are configured, either because they are included in the same measConfig (in the measObjectToAddModList and/or reportConfigToAddModList) or because they were already configured previously.
